title: Compass: Co-Exploration of Mapping and Hardware for Heterogeneous Multi-Chiplet Accelerators Targeting LLM Inference Service Workloads
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) bring huge computational demands, which makes multi-chiplet accelerators that can integrate large-scale computing resources a powerful solution. However, existing design space exploration (DSE) efforts for such accelerators primarily focus on traditional CNN/Transformer workloads and fall short in supporting the highly dynamic behavior of real-world LLM inference services. This dynamic nature manifests in two key aspects: 1) Mixed request types: the prefill and decode phases exhibit significantly different computational patterns and are frequently interleaved by modern system-level service schedulers; 2) Variable sequence lengths: the sequence length differences across requests can span several orders of magnitude, rendering padding-based assumptions inefficient. Moreover, many prior works assume homogeneous chiplets and overlook the potential beneficial interaction between LLM dynamics and heterogeneous chiplet architectures. To bridge this gap, we introduce Compass, a co-exploration framework designed to optimize mapping strategies and hardware design for multi-chiplet accelerators, specifically tailored for dynamic LLM workloads. First, we propose a computation execution graph-based mapping encoding scheme that decouples micro-batch and layer dimensions, enabling fine-grained execution control on heterogeneous chiplets and flexibly representing various parallelism strategies. Second, based on this scheme, we develop the Compass framework itself, which integrates an evaluation engine, a mapping generation engine based on genetic algorithm, and a hardware sampling engine based on Bayesian optimization, enabling fast and flexible cross-level co-design. Compared with the SOTA DSE works Gemini and MOHaM, Compass reduces latency by 63.92\% and energy by 40.32\% on average in various scenarios, with only a 3.11\% increase in monetary cost.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 大语言模型(LLMs)带来了巨大的计算需求,这使得能够集成大规模计算资源的多芯粒加速器成为强大的解决方案. 然而,目前对这类加速器的设计空间探索(DSE)努力主要侧重于传统CNN/Transformer工作负载,在支持现实世界LLM推理服务的高度动态行为方面还不足. 这种动态性质表现在两个关键方面:1) 混合请求类型: 预填和解码阶段表现出显著不同的计算模式,并且经常被现代系统级服务调度器隔开; 2)可变序列长度:不同请求之间的序列长度差异可以跨越多个数量级,使得基于补丁的假设效率低下. 此外,许多先前的作品都假定了同质芯片,忽略了LLM动态和异构芯片架构之间潜在的有益互动. 为了弥合这一差距,我们引入了Compass,一个共同探索框架,旨在优化绘图战略,并为多芯粒加速器引入硬件设计,专门针对动态LLM工作负载. 首先,我们提出一个基于计算执行图的绘图编码方案,将微批和层维脱钩,使异构芯片能够精细地进行执行控制,并灵活地代表各种平行战略。 第二,基于这个方案,我们开发了Compass框架本身,它集成了一个评价引擎,一个基于遗传算法的绘图生成引擎,以及一个基于巴耶斯优化的硬件采样引擎,使得快速和灵活的跨层共设计成为可能. 与SOTADSE作品双子座和MOHaM,Compass作品相比,在各种情景中平均能耗减少63.92%,能耗减少40.32%,货币成本仅增加3.11%.

innovation_source: To bridge this gap, we introduce Compass, a co-exploration framework designed to optimize mapping strategies and hardware design for multi-chiplet accelerators, specifically tailored for dynamic LLM workloads.

First, we propose a computation execution graph-based mapping encoding scheme that decouples micro-batch and layer dimensions, enabling fine-grained execution control on heterogeneous chiplets and flexibly representing various parallelism strategies.

Second, based on this scheme, we develop the Compass framework itself, which integrates an evaluation engine, a mapping generation engine based on genetic algorithm, and a hardware sampling engine based on Bayesian optimization, enabling fast and flexible cross-level co-design.

title: RISC-V Based TinyML Accelerator for Depthwise Separable Convolutions in Edge AI
abstract: The increasing demand for on-device intelligence in Edge AI and TinyML applications requires the efficient execution of modern Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). While lightweight architectures like MobileNetV2 employ Depthwise Separable Convolutions (DSC) to reduce computational complexity, their multi-stage design introduces a critical performance bottleneck inherent to layer-by-layer execution: the high energy and latency cost of transferring intermediate feature maps to either large on-chip buffers or off-chip DRAM. To address this memory wall, this paper introduces a novel hardware accelerator architecture that utilizes a fused pixel-wise dataflow. Implemented as a Custom Function Unit (CFU) for a RISC-V processor, our architecture eliminates the need for intermediate buffers entirely, reducing the data movement up to 87\% compared to conventional layer-by-layer execution. It computes a single output pixel to completion across all DSC stages-expansion, depthwise convolution, and projection-by streaming data through a tightly-coupled pipeline without writing to memory. Evaluated on a Xilinx Artix-7 FPGA, our design achieves a speedup of up to 59.3x over the baseline software execution on the RISC-V core. Furthermore, ASIC synthesis projects a compact 0.284 mm$^2$ footprint with 910 mW power at 2 GHz in 28 nm, and a 1.20 mm$^2$ footprint with 233 mW power at 300 MHz in 40 nm. This work confirms the feasibility of a zero-buffer dataflow within a TinyML resource envelope, offering a novel and effective strategy for overcoming the memory wall in edge AI accelerators.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: EdgeAI和TinyML应用程序对在线智能的需求日益增加,这需要高效执行现代革命神经网络(CNNs). 虽然像MobileNetV2这样的轻量级建筑采用深智可分离共进式(DSC)来降低计算复杂度,但其多阶段设计引入了逐层执行所固有的关键性能瓶颈:将中间特征图转移到大型芯片缓冲器或离芯片DRAM的高能量和耐久性成本. 为了解决这个内存壁,本文引入了一种小说硬件加速器架构,它利用了像素向导的数据流. 作为用于RISC-V处理器的自定义函数单元(CFU)执行,我们的架构完全不需要中间缓冲器,与常规的逐层执行相比,将数据移动降至87%. 它计算出一个单一的输出像素,以完成所有DSC阶段的扩展,深度的演化,和通过紧密的串联的管道进行投影的数据,而无需写入内存. 经过对Xilinx Artix-7FPGA的评价,我们的设计在RISC-V核心的基线软件执行上实现了最高59.3x的加速. 此外,ASIC合成还预测一个紧凑的0.284毫米^2足迹,在28nm的2GHz有910mW的功率,以及一个1.20毫米^2足迹,在40nm的300MHz有233mW的功率. 这项工作证实了在TinyML资源封套内零缓冲数据流的可行性,为克服边缘的内存墙AI加速器提供了一个全新的有效的策略.

Evaluated on a Xilinx Artix-7 FPGA, our design achieves a speedup of up to 59.3x over the baseline software execution on the RISC-V core.

To address this memory wall, this paper introduces a novel hardware accelerator architecture that utilizes a fused pixel-wise dataflow.

title: CarrierKV: An Edge LLM Accelerator with Positional Carrier Decomposition for Low-Bit KV Cache
abstract: Long-context decoding on edge devices is limited by DRAM, because every generated token reads the whole, growing KV cache. 4-bit block-scaled formats such as NVFP4 reduce this traffic but degrade accuracy: on Qwen3-4B, NVFP4 lowers 32K RULER (seven tasks) from 92.6 to 79.4, and a Hadamard rotation lowers it further to 57.7. We observe that most of the key energy is a positional carrier, one per-head vector that rotary position embedding (RoPE) rotates with position. In NVFP4, it sets the shared scale of most key blocks and lowers the signal-to-quantization-noise ratio of the content by about 5 dB, nearly one bit, yet it depends only on that vector and the position. We therefore introduce positional carrier decomposition, which removes the carrier before RoPE and stores only the content residual. We design a KV path that rotates and quantizes keys only after this removal and computes each attention score directly on the 4-bit code. We also design a positional phase engine that regenerates the carrier's score term for one key per cycle. At the same cache size as NVFP4, CarrierKV raises 32K RULER on Qwen3-4B from 79.4 to 91.1 and lowers the 32K PG19 perplexity increase of NVFP4 by 1.8 to 5.9 times on four models, outperforming SageAttention and P3-LLM on all four. Its loss also stays nearly flat as the cache grows, while that of NVFP4 rises. In a 22 nm FDSOI process at 600 MHz, CarrierKV's hardware increases the area of the NVFP4 accelerator by 2.9% and the energy of a 20K-token reasoning request on Qwen3-4B by 0.12% at the same decode latency. On Qwen3-4B at 32K, CarrierKV has a better RULER score than FP8 keys (91.1 against 89.3) and uses 13.7% less energy per token. The decomposition also lowers the 32K perplexity increase of 3-bit TurboQuant keys on Qwen3-4B from 69.7 to 0.76.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 边缘设备做长上下文解码时，每生成一个 token 都需读取持续增长的 KV 缓存，因而受 DRAM 限制。NVFP4 等四位分块缩放格式能减少流量，但在 Qwen3-4B 上将 32K RULER 七项任务的得分从 92.6 降至 79.4，叠加 Hadamard 旋转后进一步降为 57.7。作者发现，键向量的多数能量来自每个注意力头的一个位置载波向量。该向量随旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）改变方向，并主导大多数 NVFP4 键块的共享缩放因子，使内容的信号与量化噪声比降低约 5 dB。CarrierKV 在 RoPE 前分离并移除位置载波，只旋转、量化和存储内容残差，在四位编码上直接计算内容的注意力分数，再由位置相位引擎以每周期一个键的吞吐重建载波分数项。在缓存与 NVFP4 同样大小时，Qwen3-4B 的 32K RULER 得分升至 91.1，四个模型的 32K PG19 困惑度增幅降为 NVFP4 增幅的约 1/5.9–1/1.8。22 nm FDSOI、600 MHz 的实现相对 NVFP4 加速器增加 2.9% 面积，Qwen3-4B 的 20K-token 推理请求能耗增加 0.12%，解码延迟相同。在 32K 上，它的 RULER 得分高于 FP8 键（91.1 对 89.3），每 token 能耗低 13.7%。同一分解还将三位 TurboQuant 键在 Qwen3-4B 上的 32K 困惑度增幅从 69.7 降至 0.76。
takeaway: 将支配缩放因子的位置载波从内容中分离，可使四位 KV 缓存保留更多内容信息。在同等 NVFP4 缓存容量下，Qwen3-4B 的 32K RULER 从 79.4 升至 91.1，硬件面积增加 2.9%，解码延迟相同。
innovation: 提出 RoPE 前的位置载波分解，把高能量位置项从低比特内容编码中移出，并用四位直接算分通路和位置相位引擎分别计算两部分贡献。

title: KD-DSE: A Knowledge-Driven LLM Framework for Fast Microarchitecture Design Space Exploration
abstract: Domain-specific architectures have made design space exploration (DSE) a bottleneck of processor design, yet each candidate costs a full simulation, so exhaustive search is out of reach. Surrogate models need thousands of simulations before they predict reliably, and LLM agents that search directly hallucinate, lack cold-start architectural knowledge, and follow a fixed per-round policy. We present KD-DSE, a knowledge- driven LLM framework for fast microarchitecture DSE. KD- DSE couples a five-state constrained agent with real gem5- McPAT evaluation, retrieves architect-curated guidance from an Architecture Knowledge Base conditioned on the current search state and bottleneck diagnosis, and allocates its budget with a diagnosis-guided two-phase exploration strategy. On a 29- parameter out-of-order core with a budget of 18 simulations, KD-DSE achieves about 4.8% higher hypervolume and about 21.7% lower ADRS than the state-of-the-art MicroEvo, and the ablation attributes the gain chiefly to the Knowledge Base. These results indicate that constraining LLM reasoning and grounding it in architectural knowledge can drive fast and effective microarchitecture DSE. The code will be open-sourced upon acceptance.
abstract_cn: 特定域的架构使得设计空间探索(DSE)成为了处理器设计的瓶颈,然而每个候选方都花费了一次全面的模拟,所以详尽无遗的搜索是无法达到的. 代理模型在可靠预测前需要上千个模拟,LLM代理搜索直接产生幻觉,缺乏冷启动的建筑知识,并遵循固定的每轮政策. 我们提出了KD-DSE,一个知识驱动的LLM框架,用于快速微体系结构DSE. KD-DSE 配对一种五态受限剂,具有真正的宝石5 - McPAT评价,从建筑知识库中检索建筑师精准的指南,以当前搜索状态和瓶颈诊断为条件,并以诊断指导的两阶段探索战略分配其预算. 【该句原文】On a 29- parameter out-of-order core with a budget of 18 simulations, KD-DSE achieves about 4.8% higher hypervolume and about 21.7% lower ADRS than the state-of-the-art MicroEvo, and the ablation attributes the gain chiefly to the Knowledge Base. 这些结果表明,限制LLM推理并将其扎根于建筑知识可以推动快速有效的微体系结构DSE. 该代码在被接受后会开源.
takeaway: 在具有 29 个设计参数的乱序核上，使用 18 次模拟的 KD-DSE 相比 MicroEvo 将超体积提高约 4.8%，将 ADRS 降低约 21.7%。消融实验将主要收益归因于知识库。
innovation: 1. 我们提出了KD-DSE,一个知识驱动的LLM框架,用于快速微体系结构DSE.
takeaway_source: On a 29- parameter out-of-order core with a budget of 18 simulations, KD-DSE achieves about 4.8% higher hypervolume and about 21.7% lower ADRS than the state-of-the-art MicroEvo, and the ablation attributes the gain chiefly to the Knowledge Base.
innovation_source: We present KD-DSE, a knowledge- driven LLM framework for fast microarchitecture DSE.

title: SlipStream: Enabling HBF for GPU Systems by Mitigating the Latency and SRAM Overheads
abstract:
Large language model (LLM) inference demands ever more memory capacity for larger models and batch sizes. High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) replaces the DRAM dies of HBM with NAND flash and provides up to 16x the capacity at comparable read bandwidth. However, HBF can incur a read latency of nearly 20$μ$s, 20x that of HBM, so on-demand HBF accesses slow inference by up to 12.8x. Conventional cache-line prefetchers require 20x more in-flight tracking state to cover this latency. Tensor-streaming designs, such as H3, follow virtual-address order as opposed to kernel-demand order, and therefore need hundreds of megabytes of buffering.
  We propose SlipStream, a software-hardware co-designed prefetcher that turns prefetching into a demand-paced producer-consumer pipeline. In software, SlipStream profiles the repeatable weight-page demand order of data-independent LLM kernels and inserts a staging warp that replays this order with non-blocking STAGE instructions. In hardware, the staging warp acts as the producer and the work warps as consumers. Our key insight is to retire each STAGE tracking entry only when demand first accesses the page, as opposed to when the page returns from HBF. Demand thus paces staging and bounds how far staging leads consumption. SlipStream tracks 4 KB pages instead of cache lines and allocates buffer slots only when pages return, which decouples the buffer size from outstanding traffic. Across seven dense models spanning 16-800 GB, SlipStream with a 40 MB staging buffer achieves 92.4% of the performance of an ideal HBF with HBM-like latency. H3 achieves only 43.1%, even with a 320 MB buffer. The buffer sizing of SlipStream is independent of HBF latency and workload. SlipStream with 16 MB buffer, 20x smaller than that of H3, performs within 4% of SlipStream-40MB. SlipStream also supports Mixture-of-Experts models and reaches 91.2% of ideal performance (40 MB buffer).
abstract_cn: 大语言模型(LLM)推理对更大的模型和批量大小要求有越来越多的内存能力. High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) 将 DRAM die of HBM 替换为 NAND flash ,并以可比的读带宽提供最多16x的容量. 然而,HBF可能会发生近20μs,20xHBM的读滞,因此点播HBF访问速度缓慢推理,最高可达12.8x. 常规缓存线预牵引器需要20x多的飞行中跟踪状态才能覆盖这一空隙. tensor-流线设计,如H3,遵循虚拟地址顺序而不是内核-需求顺序,因此需要数百兆字节的缓冲. 我们提议SlipStream,一个软件硬件共同设计的预发器,它把预发器变成一个需求速度的生产者-消费者管道. 在软件中,SlipStream配置了数据独立的LLM内核的可重复重页需求顺序,并插入一个中转曲面,以非屏蔽STAGE指令重播此顺序. 在硬件中,中导曲速充当制片人,工作曲速充当消费者. 我们的关键洞察力是,只有在要求首先访问页面时,而不是在页面从HBF返回时,才会取消每个STAGE跟踪条目. 因此,需求加快了中转速度,并限制了中转多远导致消费。 SlipStream 音轨 4 KB 页面,而不是缓存行,仅在页面返回时分配缓冲槽,从而将缓冲大小与未完成流量脱钩. 【该句原文】Across seven dense models spanning 16-800 GB, SlipStream with a 40 MB staging buffer achieves 92.4% of the performance of an ideal HBF with HBM-like latency. H3仅实现43.1%,即使有一个320MB的缓冲. SlipStream的缓冲大小独立于HBF纬度和工作负载. SlipStream,有16个MB缓冲器,比H3小20x,在SlipStream-40MB的4%范围内完成. SlipStream还支持Mixture-of-Experts模型,并达到理想性能的91.2%(40 MB 缓冲).
takeaway: 【该句原文】Across seven dense models spanning 16-800 GB, SlipStream with a 40 MB staging buffer achieves 92.4% of the performance of an ideal HBF with HBM-like latency. H3仅实现43.1%,即使有一个320MB的缓冲.
innovation: 1. 我们提议SlipStream,一个软件硬件共同设计的预发器,它把预发器变成一个需求速度的生产者-消费者管道.
takeaway_source: Across seven dense models spanning 16-800 GB, SlipStream with a 40 MB staging buffer achieves 92.4% of the performance of an ideal HBF with HBM-like latency.
H3 achieves only 43.1%, even with a 320 MB buffer.
innovation_source: We propose SlipStream, a software-hardware co-designed prefetcher that turns prefetching into a demand-paced producer-consumer pipeline.

title: PENSA: A Spatial Accelerator for BitNet b1.58 Inference on an HBM-equipped AMD Alveo FPGA
abstract: Ternary large language models (tLLMs) replace general multiplication in dominant linear layers with sign-controlled accumulation, shifting hardware bottlenecks toward packed-weight delivery, reduction, and operator occupancy. PENSA is an end-to-end FPGA accelerator for the BitNet b1.58 2B4T model on an AMD Alveo U50. Two row-partitioned ternary matrix engines consume packed TQ1_0 weights from eight independent high-bandwidth memory (HBM) pseudo-channels, each processing 1,280 ternary weights per cycle through sign selection and integer reduction. The sequencer, attention, and vocabulary-projection units remain resident on the FPGA, while two-stream interleaved scheduling overlaps sequences across the persistent pipeline to form the Penta-Unit. At 104.1~MHz, PENSA achieves 58.09 tok/s at context 128 and 24.60 tok/s at context 2048, corresponding to 2.14-3.14$\times$ the throughput of a same-model Xeon E-2356G baseline. The resulting system demonstrates end-to-end FPGA execution of 2B-scale BitNet topology without modifying its model structure.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算

PENSA是BitNetb1.58 2B4T型号在AMDAlveo U50上的端对端FPGA加速器. 【该句原文】Two row-partitioned ternary matrix engines consume packed TQ1_0 weights from eight independent high-bandwidth memory (HBM) pseudo-channels, each processing 1,280 ternary weights per cycle through sign selection and integer reduction. 测序器,注意,和词汇投影单元仍停留在FPGA上,而两流互换的排行顺序则重叠在持久性管道上形成Penta-Unit. 在104.1~MHz,PENSA在上下文128实现58.09吨/秒,在上下文2048实现24.60吨/秒,对应2.14-3.14×相同型号的XeonE-2356G基线的吞吐量. 由此形成的系统演示了2B级BitNet地形的端对端FPGA执行,而不修改其模型结构.

title: RoadBlock: Rethinking GPU Tensor Core Microarchitecture for Emerging Microscaling Format Support
abstract: While multiple recent custom Microscaling (MX) format proposals preserve higher model quality over OCP MX, their hardware evaluations remain confined to standalone MAC-unit prototypes, ignoring the system-level integration overheads inside real GPU Tensor Cores. To this end, we present RoadBlock, an open-source framework for accurate end-to-end modeling of custom MX formats in a programmable Tensor Core, built on the RISC-V Vortex GPGPU. RoadBlock exposes data size, scale-factor size, and block size as configurable parameters and automatically derives per-thread metadata tiling for arbitrary formats, enabling format-specific Perplexity-PPA tradeoff evaluation before silicon commitment.
abstract_cn: 虽然最近有多个定制的微缩(MX)格式提案比OCPMX保留了更高的模型质量,但其硬件评价仍然局限于独立的MAC-unit原型,忽略了系统级集成在真实GPU张量核心内部的间接费用. 为此,我们提出RoadBlock,即基于RISC-V Vortex GPGPU的可编程的Tensor Core中准确的自定义MX格式端到端模型的开源框架. RoadBlock 将数据大小,缩放因子大小,块大小等作为可配置参数进行曝光,并自动获得任意格式的每行元数据槽,使特定格式Perplexity-PPA在硅承诺之前进行权衡评价.

title: Memory Admission and Result-Retention Sizing in an RV32IMC FPGA Soft Processor
abstract: In FPGA soft processors with shared backing block RAM, memory admission can stall a multiplication after its product has been prepared. We study how admission timing changes result retention in PaceRV, our board-tested five-stage RV32IMC core, using fixed binaries and matched dynamic instructions. Offering data requests one edge earlier reduces geometric-mean Embench cycles by 18.2% and retention opportunities from 375,063 to 4,373. Admission and retention cycle gains are conditional and non-additive. Under slower reads, a 99% capture target selects an 18-edge validity window with registered requests and 28 edges with early requests, although no multiplication matched within both measurement intervals waits longer. A predeclared sizing rule predicts opportunity recovery exactly in all finite tests, including kernels excluded from model development. Independent timing analysis closely estimates execution-cycle savings. The results support choosing admission first, then deciding whether to extend validity and sizing it against an explicit capture or missed-opportunity objective.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 在FPGA具有共享支撑块的软处理器RAM中,内存录入可以在产品制备后延缓乘法. 我们研究录取时间的变化如何导致PaceRV,我们的板测试的五级RV32IMC核心,使用固定的二进制和匹配的动态指令. 【该句原文】Offering data requests one edge earlier reduces geometric-mean Embench cycles by 18.2% and retention opportunities from 375,063 to 4,373. 招生和留学周期增益是有条件和非附加的。 在较慢的读取下,99%的捕捉目标会选择一个带有已注册请求的18个尖端有效性窗口和28个带有早期请求的边缘,尽管两个测量间隔内没有匹配的乘法等待更长的时间. 预先宣布的大小规则预测,在所有有限测试中,包括被排除在模型开发之外的内核,机会恢复是准确的。 独立的时间安排分析密切估计执行周期的节余。 结果支持首先选择接纳,然后决定是否扩大有效性,并根据明确的捕捉目标或错失机会目标来决定其规模。

title: LLM Agent-Based Design of RISC-V CPUs with FPGA-in-the-Loop Evaluation
abstract: Long-run RTL simulation of CPU candidates can take hours, while short diagnostic runs may miss performance degradation that emerges later in execution. This evaluation cost can delay design decisions in LLM-agent-based CPU development. We present a development environment in which LLM agents implement CPU candidates on an FPGA and use on-board performance measurements to guide design decisions. We applied it to the human-supervised development of a single-cycle RV32I core into a three-wide out-of-order RV32IM core. The final design reaches 5.61 CoreMark/MHz at 130 MHz on a Artix-7 FPGA. For the same CPU candidate running 8,000 CoreMark iterations, FPGA evaluation, including implementation, was 9.6x faster than single-threaded RTL simulation. In one case, board measurements revealed long-run performance degradation in a candidate that improved in a short diagnostic run. The result guided candidate selection and led to RTL-based root-cause analysis and a fix.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 长期 RTL 模拟 CPU 考生需要几个小时的时间,而短暂的诊断运行可能会错过后来在执行过程中出现的性能退化. 这种评价成本可以延迟LLM-agent-basedCPU开发中的设计决定. 我们提出的发展环境是,LLM代理在FPGA上执行CPU候选人,并利用船上的性能测量来指导设计决定。 我们把它应用于由人类监督的单循环RV32I核心发展成三宽乱序RV32IM核心. 最终设计达到5.61 CoreMark/MHz,在Artix-7 FPGA上的130 MHz. 【该句原文】For the same CPU candidate running 8,000 CoreMark iterations, FPGA evaluation, including implementation, was 9.6x faster than single-threaded RTL simulation. 在一个案例中,董事会测量显示一名候选人的长期性能退化,短期诊断有所改善。 这一结果指导了候选人的甄选,并导致RTL-based 根因分析和固定。
takeaway: 在一个案例中,董事会测量显示一名候选人的长期性能退化,短期诊断有所改善。
innovation: 1. 我们提出的发展环境是,LLM代理在FPGA上执行CPU候选人,并利用船上的性能测量来指导设计决定。

title: PaFeDSE: Pareto-Feedback-Guided Microarchitecture Design Space Exploration for Efficient Pareto Search
abstract: Efficient microarchitecture design space exploration (DSE) is critical for optimizing performance, power, and area trade-offs in modern out-of-order processors. While machine-learning-based DSE significantly reduces the cost of exhaustively evaluating large design spaces, existing methods still waste expensive simulations on Pareto-miss candidates that do not improve the Pareto frontier and repeatedly process redundant candidates during iterative exploration. In this paper, we propose PaFeDSE, a Pareto-feedback-guided microarchitecture DSE framework for efficient Pareto search. PaFeDSE leverages Pareto-hit feedback to prioritize candidates likely to improve the frontier and Pareto-miss feedback to suppress exploration of unpromising local regions, while filtering redundant candidates that remain low priority across iterations. Evaluated on SPEC CPU 2017 workloads, PaFeDSE requires up to 49.0% fewer simulations than the strongest prior baseline to reach target hypervolume levels, while achieving a 7.1x reduction in exploration overhead through adaptive candidate filtering.
abstract_cn: 高效的微体系结构 设计空间探索(DSE)对于优化现代乱序处理器的性能,功率,以及地区权衡至关重要. 虽然基于机器的学习DSE大大降低了详尽评估大型设计空间的成本,但现有方法仍然浪费了对Pareto-miss候选人的昂贵模拟,这些模拟没有改善Pareto前沿,并且在迭代探索中反复处理冗余候选人. 在本文中,我们提出PaFeDSE,一个Pareto-feedback-guided 微体系结构DSE高效Pareto搜索的框架. PaFeDSE利用Pareto-hit反馈来优先安排可能改善前沿和Pareto-miss反馈的候选人,以压制对不充满希望的局部区域的探索,同时过滤各个迭代中仍然处于低优先度的冗余候选人. 在SPEC CPU 2017 工作负载,PaFeDSE上进行的评估,需要比上一个最强的基准进行多达49.0%的模拟才能达到目标超量量水平,同时通过适应性候选过滤实现7.1x的勘探间接费用减少.

title: SUSpMV: A High Frequency Sparse Matrix Vector Multiplier on HBM Enabled FPGA written in SUS
abstract:
SUSpMV is a Sparse Matrix Vector multiplication (SpMV) accelerator written in the upcoming HDL SUS. By leveraging SUS's unique latency counting and inference mechanism, SUSpMV could be designed with very deep pipelines yet small design complexity overhead. This enables an efficient implementation which employs all 32 HBM channels on the Alveo U280 FPGA at 400MHz for streaming matrix data into 32 Compute Units (CUs). Input and output vectors are stored in DDR memory, which allows zero-overhead chaining of multiplications and increases overall system memory bandwidth by not sharing HBM bandwidth with the CUs.
  A CU processes the SpMV in tiles of width 1024 and a dynamically chosen height, up to 32768. Each CU is capable of accumulating the multiplications with up to 6 separate matrix entries per cycle, resulting in the combined theoretical peak computational throughput of 153.6 GFLOPs. The matrix storage format is designed to exploit density variation within a given matrix by dynamically switching between one representation optimized for denser regions, and a second optimized for sparser regions, allowing jumps of up to 255 rows between each entry.
  Evaluation demonstrates a 79% geometric mean improvement over prior work on the same platform. We achieve a peak throughput of 144.9 GFLOPs, or 94% of our theoretical computational throughput, compared to 98 GFLOPs reached by prior work.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: SUSpMV是一个Sparse Matrix矢量乘法(SpMV)加速器,写于即将到来的HDLSUS. 通过利用SUS独特的耐久计数和推理机制,SUSpMV可以设计有非常深的管道,但设计复杂度很小的顶部. 这样就能够有效地实施,利用Alveo U280 FPGA在400MHz上的所有32个HBM频道,将矩阵数据流到32个计算单位(CUs)。 输入和输出矢量被存储在DDR内存中,这允许零覆盖链路的乘积,并通过不与CUs共享HBM带宽来增加整体系统内存带宽. ACU在宽度1024和动态选择高度的瓦片中处理SpMV,最高可达32768. 每个CU能够以每个周期最多6个单独的矩阵条目积累乘法,导致理论峰值计算综合吞吐量达到153.6GFLOPs. 矩阵存储格式旨在利用特定矩阵内的密度差异,在为密度较大的区域优化的表示值和为稀疏区域优化的第二个表示值之间动态切换,允许每个条目之间跳跃最多255行. 【该句原文】Evaluation demonstrates a 79% geometric mean improvement over prior work on the same platform. 我们实现了最高吞吐量144.9GFLOPs,即我们理论计算吞吐量的94%,而先前的工作达到了98GFLOPs.

title: Memory Bandwidth, Not FLOPs: Profiling and Accelerating Query-Based Segmentation Decoders on Edge GPUs
abstract: Query-based segmentation models achieve strong performance even under real-time inference on workstation GPUs. On edge devices, however, we show their transformer decoders are deeply memory-bandwidth-bound, a bottleneck invisible to standard FLOP analysis that worsens with input resolution and limited DRAM bandwidth. An FP16 roofline analysis with tensor-core GEMMs active and hardware DRAM counters shows that the non-tensor-core aggregates of FastInst and Mask2Former reach only $2.5\%$ to $6\%$ of the CUDA-core ridge yet account for $53\%$ to $70\%$ of decoder time and $61\%$ to $71\%$ of decoder bytes. The largest individual kernels sustain up to $90\%$ of nominal peak DRAM bandwidth, effectively saturating the memory bus. The bottleneck is therefore not primarily low GEMM intensity, but cross-kernel activation traffic. CompactInst addresses this bottleneck using parameter-free spatial pooling at $4{\times}$, which reduces the bytes moved within the transformer decoder, while a two-convolution refinement head recovers spatial detail. Under TensorRT FP16 on Jetson Orin Nano, CompactInst delivers decoder speedups from $2.35{\times}$ to $4.74{\times}$ and model speedups from $1.57{\times}$ to $2.62{\times}$ as input resolution grows, while closely matching accuracy ($-0.4$ AP on COCO val2017, $+0.2$ AP on Cityscapes test). A heavier variant with $2.57{\times}$ more decoder FLOPs still runs its decoder $1.74{\times}$ faster on the most bandwidth-constrained device, confirming at the deployment level that decoder bytes, not FLOPs, govern latency.
abstract_cn: 基于查询的分区模式即使在工作站的实时推理上也取得了强效的性能GPUs. 然而,在边缘设备上,我们显示他们的变压器解码器是深度内存带宽的,这是标准FLOP的隐形瓶颈分析,随着输入分辨率和有限的DRAM带宽而恶化. 有FP16 屋顶线分析显示,有拉诺核心 GEMMs 活性与硬件 DRAM 计数器显示,FastInst和Mask2Former 的非收纳核心总和仅达到CUDA-core山脊的2.5%至6%,但占解码时间的53%至70%,占解码字节的61%至71%. 最大的单个内核维持高达90%的名义峰DRAM带宽,有效饱和内存总线. 因此,瓶颈主要不是低GEMM强度,而是跨内核激活流量. CompactInst利用4 ?? 的无参数空间集合来解决这个瓶颈,这减少了变压器解码器内移动的字节,而一个两进制的改进头则恢复空间细节. 【该句原文】Under TensorRT FP16 on Jetson Orin Nano, CompactInst delivers decoder speedups from 2.35{×} to 4.74{×} and model speedups from 1.57{×} to 2.62{×} as input resolution grows, while closely matching accuracy (-0.4 AP on COCO val2017, +0.2 AP on Cityscapes test). 【该句原文】A heavier variant with 2.57{×} more decoder FLOPs still runs its decoder 1.74{×} faster on the most bandwidth-constrained device, confirming at the deployment level that decoder bytes, not FLOPs, govern latency.

title: Quantifying the Effect of HCLs on a Fixed-Microarchitecture MXFP4 Accelerator
abstract: Hardware Construction Languages (HCLs) aim to improve hardware design productivity while generating register-transfer-level (RTL) circuits without changing the designer's microarchitecture. However, most comparisons between HCLs are either qualitative or evaluate quality of results (QoR) across different designs, making it difficult to separate language effects from design effects. This paper compares the most widely used HCLs using the same fixed design, the OCP MXFP4 block dot product, a quantization primitive at the heart of edge Physical-AI inference, implemented as a single 12-stage, II=1 pipeline. A SystemVerilog baseline is followed by implementations in Chisel, SpinalHDL, Amaranth, Clash, Bluespec, and C++ for high-level synthesis (HLS). Every variant goes through the same flow on the same Artix-7 device set at 100 MhZ, driven by a RISC-V soft core. With the micro-architecture held constant, the comparison is clean: every variant meets timing, and the HCLs match or even undercut hand-written RTL in area. The remaining differences stem not from the algorithm but from how each back end lowers arithmetic, and from a single width choice that silently toggles DSP inference. Unlike HLS, where design decisions are limited to pragmas, the HCLs achieve comparable area and timing. Therefore, the choice comes down to ecosystem fit and interface needs rather than QoR.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 硬件构造语言(HCLs)旨在提高硬件设计的生产率,同时生成寄存器-传输级(RTL)电路而不改变设计师的微体系结构. 然而,HCLs之间的大多数比较要么是定性的,要么是评价不同设计的结果的质量(QoR),因此很难将语言效果与设计效果区分开来. 【该句原文】This paper compares the most widely used HCLs using the same fixed design, the OCP MXFP4 block dot product, a quantization primitive at the heart of edge Physical-AI inference, implemented as a single 12-stage, II=1 pipeline. A SystemVerilog 基线之后是Chisel、SpinalHDL、Amaranth、Clash、Bluespec和C++的执行,用于高级综合(HLS)。 每个变体在设定为100MhZ的相同Artix-7设备上通过相同的流,由RISC-V软核驱动. 随着微结构的保持恒定,比较是干净的:每个变体都符合时间,HCLs在区域中匹配甚至下划手写RTL. 其余的区别不是来自算法,而是来自每个后端如何降低算术,以及一个默默切换DSP推理的单一宽度选择. 与HLS不同的是,设计决定仅限于practmas,HCLs实现可比较的区域和时间. 因此,选择取决于生态系统的适宜性和接口需求,而不是QoR。
takeaway: 与HLS不同的是,设计决定仅限于practmas,HCLs实现可比较的区域和时间.
innovation: 将 OCP MXFP4 块点积固定为 12 级、启动间隔为 1 的流水线，在同一 Artix-7 器件和工具流程下比较 SystemVerilog、五种硬件构建语言与 C++ HLS。这样的对照将语言与后端的影响从微架构差异中分离出来，并将剩余差异追溯到算术映射和影响 DSP 推断的位宽选择。
takeaway_source: Unlike HLS, where design decisions are limited to pragmas, the HCLs achieve comparable area and timing.

title: Hardware Trojan Threats to Multi-Chiplet Photonic Neural Network Accelerators
abstract: Multi-chiplet photonic neural network accelerators (MCPNAs) combine photonic computation, photonic communica-tion, and heterogeneous chiplet integration to enable scalable and energy-efficient AI acceleration. However, their distributed archi-tecture and reliance on third-party chiplets introduce significant hardware security risks. This paper examines Hardware Trojan (HT) threats to MCPNAs across three dimensions: confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 多芯粒 光子神经网络加速器(MCPNAs)结合光子计算,光子交流,以及异构芯片集成,使可伸缩和节能AI加速. 然而,它们的分布式拱形图案和对第三方芯片的依赖带来了巨大的硬件安全风险. 本文件从三个方面审查了硬件特洛伊(HT)对MCPNAs的威胁:保密性、完整性和可用性。
takeaway: 论文分析多芯粒光子神经网络加速器的硬件安全风险，指出分布式架构和对第三方芯粒的依赖值得从机密性、完整性与可用性三个方面审查。

title: The Road Less Traveled: Congestion-Aware NoC Placement and Packet Routing for FPGAs
abstract:
To help scale to ever-larger and more complex designs, recent FPGA architectures now integrate network-on-chips (NoCs). NoCs help transfer high-bandwidth data over long distances within the chip without using scarce low-delay long routing wire segments. While NoC-enhanced FPGAs aid system integration and design reuse, they also complicate FPGA computer-aided design (CAD) flows by introducing new constraints and metrics. Placement and routing need to optimize NoC metrics like latency and bandwidth utilization and avoid link oversubscription (congestion), while simultaneously optimizing the programmable routing resource usage of the design modules attached to NoC routers.
  In this work, we develop several new approaches to reduce NoC congestion while minimizing the impact on other design metrics. First, we incorporate a NoC link congestion cost into the placement engine of the open-source CAD flow, versatile place & route (VPR). Second, we integrate turn model NoC routing algorithms into the placement engine to leverage path diversity to further reduce congestion. On average over a suite of 29 benchmarks, combining placement congestion modeling with turn model packet routing reduces NoC congestion by 90.7% at the cost of increasing aggregate bandwidth demand by 4%. In cases where the enhanced placement engine and NoC routing fail to fully resolve congestion, we formulate NoC routing as a Boolean satisfiability (SAT) problem. This approach yields significant additional improvements; the combined algorithm reduces congestion by 95.1% compared to the baseline placement. Finally, we enhance the reinforcement learning (RL) agent in VPR's placement engine by introducing a NoC-aware move type, resulting in an 8.8% reduction in wirelength on designs that make extensive use of the NoC.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 为了帮助扩大规模,实现更大和更复杂的设计,最近的FPGA架构现在将网络集成在芯片上(NoCs). title: Beyond Capacity: Scalable MoE LLM Inference via High-Bandwidth Flash with Direct GPU and HBM Paths
abstract: Modern mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models increasingly strain the capacity and cost efficiency of high-bandwidth memory (HBM), as rapidly growing expert weights must be provisioned close to GPUs. High-bandwidth flash (HBF) offers substantially greater capacity, but conventional designs typically deliver HBF-resident expert weights to the GPU through HBM, leaving an additional direct GPU-HBF connection underutilized. We explore an HBF organization that simultaneously exploits two independent expert-delivery routes: a direct path that transfers expert weights from HBF to the GPU and a relay path that transfers them from HBF through the HBM base die to the GPU. Whole experts are assigned to one of the two routes, and transfers over both routes proceed concurrently, increasing aggregate expert-delivery bandwidth without replicating expert weights or introducing a shared relay bottleneck. Early expert determination identifies upcoming experts ahead of their conventional execution point, allowing HBF read latency to overlap with preceding computation, while separate management of immutable expert weights and mutable KV-cache data reduces interference between the two traffic classes. We evaluate the architecture using an event-driven continuous-batching LLM serving simulator with empirically measured GPU compute latencies. Across representative MoE workloads, concurrently utilizing the direct GPU-HBF and HBF-HBM-GPU routes consistently improves expert-delivery efficiency over designs restricted to either route alone. For a representative workload, the proposed architecture can achieve 1.94$\times$ higher throughput and 1.90$\times$ end-to-end speedup over a design that delivers all HBF-resident expert weights to the GPU through the HBM base die.

title: FPGA Lifecycle Management for RISC-V Systems
abstract: FPGA lifecycle management remains tied to proprietary toolchains and host architectures, leaving RISC-V without a vendor-neutral model for scalable bitstream deployment. A host-agnostic control-plane architecture is presented that shifts lifecycle management to the operating-system layer by leveraging standard Linux capabilities, thereby decoupling deployment from specific ISAs and vendor stacks. This enables Linux-capable RISC-V processors to serve as control hosts in heterogeneous FPGA systems. Prototyped on a Zynq-7000 SoC and generalizable to RISC-V platforms, the architecture provides a portable foundation for fleet-scale FPGA management.

abstract_cn: FPGA 生命周期管理仍与专有工具链和主机架构捆绑在一起,使得RISC-V没有供应商中性模式的可缩放比特流部署. 呈现出一个主机不可知控制飞机架构,通过利用标准的Linux能力,将生命周期管理转向操作系统层,从而将部署与特定的ISAs和供应商堆栈脱钩. 这使得Linux-capable RISC-V 处理器在 异构 FPGA 系统中充当控制主机. 原型为Zynq-7000SoC型,可通用为RISC-V平台,该架构为舰队规模FPGA管理提供了便携式基础.

title: C2P-Cache: Scalable GPU L1 Cache Sharing via Concurrent Candidate Pruning
abstract:
Modern GPUs rely on private per-SM L1 caches and a shared L2 cache, but this organization obscures cross-SM reuse: an L1 miss is typically forwarded to L2 even when the requested line already resides in a peer L1 cache, leading to redundant L2 access. Prior GPU L1-sharing designs attempt to recover such reuse through exact or broad remote-hit searches, which become increasingly difficult to scale and can interfere with the critical L1 miss path under high concurrency. %miss handling as more caches participate and more misses arrive concurrently. We observe that eliminating redundant L2 accesses does not require exact, chip-wide knowledge of private L1 contents. Instead, it requires only sufficient visibility to sharply narrow down a small set of candidate caches, leaving exact confirmation to a much smaller number of L1s.
  Based on this insight, we propose C2P-Cache, a scalable GPU L1-sharing mechanism that transforms remote-hit discovery from a chip-wide exact search problem into a lightweight filtering-and-confirmation process. C2P-Cache maintains compact Bloom-filter-based snapshots of private L1 tags, performs parallel chip-wide candidate filtering, and selectively probes only a small number of likely peer caches. To sustain high concurrency, C2P-Cache organizes filtering as bit-sliced matching over a banked and replicated snapshot matrix, enabling efficient, parallel processing of many concurrent misses without interfering with normal L1 accesses. Across a wide range of GPU workloads, C2P-Cache improves instructions per cycle (IPC) by up to 49.7\% and by 23.5\% on average for applications with high remote-L1 reuse and strong sensitivity to L2 latency, demonstrating that lightweight, scalable filtering can effectively unlock cross-SM reuse with modest overhead.

title: SEAM-V: A Hybrid-Decoupled RISC-V Vector Processor with Backend-Visible Packet Semantics and Source-Lifetime-Aware Scheduling
abstract: Data-parallel workloads in deep learning and scientific computing continue to increase the demands on processor throughput, energy efficiency, and scalability. The RISC-V Vector Extension (RVV) supports scalable execution through a vector-length-agnostic model, yet many tightly coupled implementations still rely on the scalar core to supply vector instructions individually and are therefore constrained by instruction supply, scalar-side progress, memory stalls, and conservative dependence management in short-vector, loop-tail, and control/memory-interleaved scenarios. This paper presents SEAM-V, a hybrid-decoupled RVV processor that uses task-level decoupling, local instruction supply, and VLIW-style packing to form a continuous stream of execute packets (EPs). During EP formation and request serialization, SEAM-V preserves the association between prefetch intent and the corresponding load to support request-bound prefetching, while lane-level source-read completion is used to release pure write-after-read (WAR) dependences early; other dependences remain governed by conventional mechanisms. Relative to an Ara-based tightly coupled baseline (TC), SEAM-V achieves a geometric mean speedup of 1.38x across 17 representative kernel configurations. The one-dimensional vector, BLAS and matrix, and fixed-size application workload groups achieve 1.56x, 1.35x, and 1.23x, respectively. Synthesis and power analysis show that SEAM-V increases total cell area by 4.29% and geometric mean runtime power by 17.30%, while reducing task energy by 12.70%, demonstrating improved sustained execution efficiency and task-level energy efficiency with limited area overhead.

title: Pattern-Guided Design Space Exploration for FPGA Accelerator Design
abstract: High-level synthesis (HLS) raises the abstraction level of FPGA accelerator design from hardware description languages to C/C++, but high-quality results still depend on schedule decisions such as pipelining, unrolling, tiling, reordering, and buffering. These decisions create a combinatorial design space, while many numerical kernels exhibit recurring computation patterns that suggest different optimization strategies. This paper presents PATTERNDSE, a lightweight pattern-guided design space exploration (DSE) framework for FPGA kernels written in Allo, a scheduling-oriented HLS programming system. PATTERNDSE maps recurring computation patterns, including elementwise maps, reductions, matrix-vector operations, matrix-matrix operations, and stencil-like updates, to compact schedule spaces. It then applies candidate schedules, validates functional correctness through LLVM execution, checks HLS C code generation, and uses a simple pattern-aware estimator to rank candidates before Vitis HLS synthesis. We evaluate PATTERNDSE on six representative kernels: vecadd, axpy, dot, matvec, gemm, and jacobi2d. Compared with an exhaustive-lite baseline, pattern-guided DSE reduces the number of HLS-evaluated candidates from 140 to 29, achieving a 4.83x overall search reduction and up to 12.0x reduction for individual kernels. Across all evaluated kernels, PATTERNDSE recovers the same best valid Vitis HLS latency as the exhaustive-lite baseline, demonstrating that computation-pattern information can prune unproductive schedule combinations while preserving high-quality HLS outcomes.

title: Residual GPU Cache State on Apple M4 Pro
abstract: Apple silicon exposes unified CPU-GPU memory, but the cache state left after a completed GPU command is not documented. This paper characterizes that phase boundary on a 14-core Apple M4 Pro. We validate the measurement pipeline against unmodified STREAM 5.10 and BabelStream 5.0, then adapt an 8192-byte system-level-cache occupancy pattern to a synchronized Metal experiment. A GPU kernel touches 0 to 512 MiB and finishes before a 16 MiB CPU probe begins. The first CPU traversal is slower after large GPU footprints, while a second traversal removes most of the cost, showing residual shared-cache displacement rather than simultaneous DRAM contention. A separate matched-block experiment measures GPU slowdown under high-priority CPU traffic and finds background QoS close to baseline. Root PMU measurements and public IOReport histograms provide hardware grounding: they distinguish L1D refill sectors from software cache-line size, expose page-offset-dependent conflict behavior, and separate performance-core, efficiency-core, and AGX demand. The results identify a reproducible post-GPU cache-displacement window on M4 Pro and quantify a simple one-pass software recovery mechanism.
abstract_cn: 苹果硅暴露了统一的CPU-GPU内存,但是一个完成的GPU命令后留下的缓存状态没有文献记载. 本文将这个相位边界定性于一个14个核心的苹果M4 Pro上. 我们对照未经修改的STREAM5.10和BabelStream5.0验证测量管道,然后将一个8192字节的系统级笼盖占用模式适应同步的金属实验. A GPU 内核触碰0至512 MiB,在16 MiB CPU 探测器开始前完成. 第一个CPU在大GPU脚印后转速较慢,而第二个转速去掉大部分成本,显示的是剩余共享-缓存位移而不是同时DRAM争用. 在高优先CPU流量下单独进行配套块实验措施GPU减速,发现背景QoS接近基线. Root PMU 测量和公 IOReport 直方图提供了硬件定位:它们将L1D重填扇区与软件缓存行大小区分开来,暴露出基于页面的冲突行为,并分别了性能核心,效率核心,以及AGX需求. 结果在M4 Pro上确定了一个可复制的post-GPU缓存-迁移窗口,并量化了一个简单的单通软件回收机制.

title: DxPTA: An Architecture Design Space Exploration with Optical Dataflow-guided Strategy for HW/SW Co-Design of Photonic Transformer Accelerators
abstract: Transformer-based networks have emerged as prominent AI models with state-of-the-art performance, which potentially pave the way toward artificial general intelligence (AGI). However, their large sizes still hinder their efficient implementation, thus highlighting the need for alternate solutions to enable their energy-efficient acceleration. Recently, state-of-the-art works propose photonic transformer accelerators (PTAs) with significant speedup and energy efficiency improvements over the conventional electronic accelerators. However, their PTA architectures are developed without considering the application constraints (e.g., area, power, energy, and latency). Moreover, their manual design approach also requires huge design time to determine a suitable architecture for the targeted application, hence making this approach not scalable. To address these limitations, we propose DxPTA, a novel design space exploration methodology for enabling efficient hardware/software co-design of the appropriate PTA architecture that meets all constraints. It is achieved by (1) identifying the PTA architecture parameters based on the coherent optical dataflow; (2) analyzing the impact/significance of the parameters; and (3) leveraging this analysis for devising a constraint-aware architecture search algorithm. Experimental results show that, our DxPTA can find the appropriate PTA architectures for different transformer-based models (i.e., DeiT-T/S/B and BERT-B/L). It achieves up to 26mm^2 area, 4.8W power, 39mJ energy, and 6ms latency, for constraints of 50mm^2 area, 5W power, 50mJ energy, and 10ms latency; with 15.2x faster searching time than the exhaustive approach. These results demonstrate the potential of DxPTA methodology for enabling efficient PTA designs for diverse AGI-based applications.

title: A PVT-Resilient Subthreshold SRAM-Based In-Memory Computing Accelerator with In-Situ Regulation for Energy-Efficient Spiking Neural Networks
abstract: This paper presents a PVT-resilient, subthreshold SRAM-based computing-in-memory (CIM) macro tailored for energy-efficient spiking neural networks (SNNs). The macro integrates in-situ current sensors and distributed voltage regulators to enable robust large-scale (1024 wordlines, 1304 bitlines and 128 shared neuron cells) subthreshold current-mode CIM, mitigating energy overheads and process-voltage-temperature (PVT) sensitivity. The neuron cells adopt a programmable, memory cell-based firing threshold to enhance neuron robustness against PVT variations. The architecture uses a stride-tick batching schedule to significantly reduce buffer overhead with enhanced input data reuse. Exploiting the high sparsity of SNNs, the proposed system demonstrates significant improvements in energy efficiency and variation tolerance. Fabricated in 28-nm CMOS, the prototype attains 93.64\% accuracy on keyword spotting, delivers up to 1181.42 TOPS/W, and achieves 7.24 TOPS/mm^2, demonstrating a viable and efficient solution for high-performance edge SNN processing.

title: Evaluating Computing Platforms for Sustainability: A Comparative Analysis of FPGAs against ASICs, GPUs, and CPUs
abstract: Climate change concerns emphasize the need for sustainable computing. Modeling the carbon footprint (CFP), including operational and embodied CFP from semiconductor use, manufacture and design, is essential. Field programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) stand out as promising platforms due to their reconfigurability across various applications, enabling the amortization of embodied CFP across multiple applications. This paper introduces GreenFPGA, a tool estimating the total CFP of FPGAs over their lifespan, considering uncertainties in CFP modeling. It accounts for CFP during design, manufacturing, reconfigurability (reuse), operation, disposal, testing, and recycling. GreenFPGA identifies deployment regimes in which FPGAs can be more sustainable than ASICs, GPUs, and CPUs under the modeled iso-performance assumptions. Experimental results highlight the importance of analyzing applications across different computing platforms to assess their CFP while varying parameters such as application type, lifetime, usage time, and volume impact their total CFP. Across the evaluated pairwise iso-performance case studies with ASICs, GPUs, and CPUs, FPGAs can be more sustainable under specific deployment regimes involving frequently changing, diverse workloads and low-volume applications.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 气候变化关切强调可持续计算的必要性。 从半导体的使用、制造和设计中模拟碳足迹(CFP),包括可操作和体现的CFP至关重要。 场可编程门阵列(FPGAs)因其跨各种应用程序的可重组性而突出为有希望的平台,使得包含的CFP的分期摊还跨多个应用程序. 本文件介绍了GreenFPGA,这是一个工具,考虑到CFP建模中的不确定性,估计了CFP在其寿命期间的总FPGAs。 它在设计、制造、重新配置(再使用)、操作、处置、测试和再循环过程中核算CFP。 GreenFPGA 确定在模型异效假设下FPGAs比ASICs,GPUs和CPUs更可持续的部署制度. 实验结果突出了分析不同计算平台的应用以评估其CFP的重要性,同时不同的参数,如应用类型、寿命、使用时间和体积影响其总量CFP。 在经过评估的对等异性能案例研究中,在涉及频繁变化、多样化工作负载和低量应用的具体部署制度下,与ASICs、GPUs和CPUs、FPGAs的对等性能案例研究可以更具可持续性。

title: A Comparative Analysis of ARM and x86-64 Laptop-Class Processors: Architecture, Assembly-Level Performance, and Energy Efficiency
abstract: ARM-based and x86-64 laptop processors differ not only in instruction-set design, but also in memory hierarchy, core organization, system integration, and power-management mechanisms. This study presents a combined architectural and experimental comparison of an Apple M3 system and an AMD Ryzen 7 3750H system. The architectural analysis contrasts AArch64's fixed-width load-store design with the variable-length, memory-operand-rich x86-64 instruction model, and discusses how register organization, calling conventions, heterogeneous core organization, memory behavior, and low-power mechanisms shape observed performance and energy characteristics. The experimental part uses two native assembly benchmarks: a recursive Fibonacci workload and an integer matrix-multiplication workload. The analysis combines repeated timing measurements, processor-energy measurements, and cross-platform microarchitectural counter measurements from matched portable-C profiling runs. The Ryzen platform is decisively faster on the branch-heavy Fibonacci benchmark, while matrix multiplication shows no meaningful timing advantage for either platform in the present measurements. In contrast, the Apple platform is markedly more energy-efficient, reducing energy-to-solution by approximately 5.82$\times$ on Fibonacci and 6.38$\times$ on matrix multiplication. These results are interpreted as platform-level findings rather than as pure ISA-only effects, reflecting differences in implementation, system integration, and measurement methodology in addition to instruction-set structure.

Ryzen平台在分支重的Fibonacci基准上具有决定性的更快性,而矩阵乘法表明,在当前测量中,这两个平台都没有有意义的时间优势。 相比之下,苹果平台的能效明显提高,在Fibonacci上减少了大约5.82×的能量到溶液,在矩阵乘法上减少了6.38×. 这些结果被解释为平台层面的结论,而不是纯ISA-only效应,反映了除指令设置结构外,在实施、系统集成和计量方法方面的差异。

title: Predictive Multi-Tier Memory Management for KV Cache in Large-Scale GPU Inference
abstract: Key-value (KV) cache memory management is the primary bottleneck limiting throughput and cost-efficiency in large-scale GPU inference serving. Current systems suffer from three compounding inefficiencies: (1) the absence of unified KV cache sizing across all attention architectures--particularly multi-head latent attention (MLA), which is unsupported in general-purpose frameworks, resulting in up to 57x memory over-provisioning; (2) confinement of KV cache to a single memory tier (GPU HBM) despite the availability of a rich hierarchy spanning CPU DRAM, CXL-attached memory, NVMe via GPUDirect Storage, RDMA fabric, and parallel filesystems; and (3) reactive eviction policies that discard reusable state, forcing redundant recomputation. We present a unified system addressing all three. Our architecture-variant-aware sizing engine computes exact memory requirements per attention type; the resulting batch size gain reaches 7.4x for the one MLA model we evaluate (DeepSeek-V3), while the three GQA models see 1.0x, 1.0x, and 0.7x, so the GQA benefit is fleet-wide unified sizing rather than larger per-model batches. A six-tier memory hierarchy extends effective KV cache capacity from 40 GB to over 38 TB per node while maintaining sub-millisecond time-to-first-token (TTFT) for hot entries. A Bayesian reuse predictor with Beta conjugate priors over 16 (block-type, transition-type) pairs drives EMA-scored head-granular eviction and RoPE-aware prefetching. Component-level validation on trace replay using ShareGPT, LMSYS-Chat-1M, and agentic workloads demonstrates 70-84% cache hit rates. Analytical projections combining validated component behavior with published hardware specifications indicate TTFT reductions of 1.4x to 2.1x, throughput improvements of 1.7x to 2.9x, and 47% cost reduction relative to published baselines; these cluster-scale projections are analytical and carry no error bars.

title: GEN-Graph: Heterogeneous PIM Accelerator for General Computational Patterns in Graph-based Dynamic Programming
abstract:
While graph-based dynamic programming (DP) is a cornerstone of genomics and network analytics, its efficiency is hampered by fundamentally conflicting computational patterns. Matrix-centric DP drives regular, compute-bound network analytics, while topology-centric DP handles irregular, memory-bound genomic traversals. These two categories of DP have substantially different computation patterns and dataflows, which makes it difficult for a single homogeneous processing-in-memory (PIM) architecture to efficiently support both.
  This work presents GEN-Graph, a novel heterogeneous PIM chiplet that integrates two types of specialized compute tiles within a 2.5D package: Matrix-tile, a processing-using-memory (PUM) tile optimized for matrix-centric workloads, such as all-pairs shortest path (APSP); and traversal-tile, a processing-near-memory (PNM) tile optimized for traversal-centric DP workloads, such as DNA sequence alignment. Our hardware-software co-design employs recursive partitioning and reconfigurable windowed bit-parallel logic to ensure exact computation. Results show the matrix tile achieves 42.8x speedup and 392x energy efficiency over the NVIDIA H100 GPU for APSP. For sequence-to-graph alignment, the traversal tile sustains 2.56 million reads/s (short-reads) and 39.3 thousand reads/s (long-reads), outperforming state-of-the-art accelerators by up to 2.56x in throughput. GEN-Graph provides the first scalable, exact solution for general DP dataflows by matching hardware specialization to algorithmic structure.

title: Rethinking Compute Substrates for 3D-Stacked Near-Memory LLM Decoding: Microarchitecture-Scheduling Co-Design
abstract: Large language model (LLM) decoding is a major inference bottleneck because its low arithmetic intensity makes performance highly sensitive to memory bandwidth. 3D-stacked near-memory processing (NMP) provides substantially higher local memory bandwidth than conventional off-chip interfaces, making it a promising substrate for decode acceleration. However, our analysis shows that this bandwidth advantage also shifts many decode operators on 3D-stacked NMP back into the compute-bound regime. Under the tight area budget of the logic die, the design of the compute substrate itself therefore becomes a first-order challenge. Therefore, we rethink the compute microarchitecture of prior 3D-stacked NMP designs. First, we replace prior MAC tree-based compute units with a more area-efficient systolic array, and we further observe that decode operators exhibit substantial shape diversity, making reconfigurability in both systolic array shape and dataflow essential for sustaining high utilization. Building on this insight, we continue to exploit two key opportunities: the high local memory bandwidth reduces the need for large on-chip buffers, and the existing vector core, originally designed to handle auxiliary tensor computations, already provides much of the control logic and multi-ported buffering required for fine-grained flexibility for systolic array, allowing us to unify the two structures in a highly area-efficient manner. Based on these insights, we present the first compute microarchitecture tailored to 3D-stacked NMP LLM decoding, explicitly designed to satisfy the joint requirements of low area cost, high-bandwidth operation, and fine-grained reconfigurability. We further propose an multi-core scheduling framework. Compared with Stratum, our design achieves an average 2.91x speedup and 2.40x higher energy efficiency across both dense and MoE models.

title: MINISA: Minimal Instruction Set Architecture for Next-gen Reconfigurable Inference Accelerator
abstract: Modern reconfigurable AI accelerators rely on rich mapping and data-layout flexibility to sustain high utilization across matrix multiplication, convolution, and emerging applications beyond AI. However, exposing this flexibility through fine-grained micro-control results in prohibitive control overhead of fetching configuration bits from off-chip memory. This paper presents MINISA, a minimal instruction set that programs a reconfigurable accelerator at the granularity of Virtual Neurons (VNs), the coarsest control granularity that retains flexibility of hardware and the finest granularity that avoids unnecessary control costs. First, we introduce FEATHER+, a modest refinement of FEATHER, that eliminates redundant on-chip replication needed for runtime dataflow/layout co-switching and supports dynamic cases where input and weight data are unavailable before execution for offline layout manipulation. MINISA then abstracts control of FEATHER+ into three layout-setting instructions for input, weight, and output VNs and a single mapping instruction for setting dataflow. This reduces the control and instruction footprint while preserving the legal mapping and layout space supported by the FEATHER+. Our results show that MINISA reduces geometric mean off-chip instruction traffic by factors ranging from 35x to (4x10^5)x under various sizes under 50 GEMM workloads spanning AI (GPT-oss), FHE, and ZKP. This eliminates instruction-fetch stalls that consume 96.9% of micro-instruction cycles, yielding up to 31.6x end-to-end speedup for 16x256 FEATHER+. Our code: https://github.com/maeri-project/FEATHER/tree/main/minisa.

title: Interconnect-Aware Logic Resynthesis for Multi-Die FPGAs
abstract: Multi-die FPGAs enable device scaling beyond reticle limits but introduce severe interconnect overhead across die boundaries. Inter-die connections, commonly referred to as super-long lines (SLLs), incur high delay and consume scarce interposer interconnect resources, often dominating critical paths and complicating physical design. To address this, this work proposes an interconnect-aware logic resynthesis method that restructures the LUT-level netlist to reduce the number of SLLs. The resynthesis engine uses die partitioning information to apply logic resubstitutions, which simplifies local circuit structures and eliminates SLLs. By reducing the number of SLLs early in the design flow, prior to physical implementation, the proposed method shortens critical paths, alleviates pressure on scarce interposer interconnect resources, and improves overall physical design flexibility. We further build a tool flow for multi-die FPGAs by integrating the proposed resynthesis method with packing and placement. Experimental results on the EPFL benchmarks show that, compared with a state-of-the-art framework, the proposed method reduces the number of SLLs by up to 24.8% for a 2-die FPGA and up to 27.38% for a 3-die FPGA. On MCNC benchmarks, our tool flow achieves an average SLL reduction of 1.65% while preserving placement quality. On Koios benchmarks, where fewer removable SLLs exist, several designs still exhibit considerable inter-die edge reductions. Overall, the results confirm that reducing inter-die connections at the logic level is an effective approach for multi-die FPGAs.

title: Performance Analysis of Edge and In-Sensor AI Processors: A Comparative Review
abstract: This review examines the rapidly evolving landscape of ultra-low-power edge processors, covering heterogeneous Systems-on-Chips (SoCs), neural accelerators, near-sensor and in-sensor architectures, and emerging dataflow and memory-centric designs. We categorize commercially available and research-grade platforms according to their compute paradigms, power envelopes, and memory hierarchies, and analyze their suitability for always-on and latency-critical Artificial Intelligence (AI) workloads. To complement the architectural overview with empirical evidence, we benchmark a 336 million Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) segmentation model (PicoSAM2) on three representative processors: GAP9, leveraging a multi-core RISC-V architecture augmented with hardware accelerators; the STM32N6, which pairs an advanced ARM Cortex-M55 core with a dedicated neural architecture accelerator; and the Sony IMX500, representing in-sensor stacked-Complementary Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor (CMOS) compute. Collectively, these platforms span MCU-class, embedded neural accelerator, and in-sensor paradigms. The evaluation reports latency, inference efficiency, energy efficiency, and energy-delay product. The results show a clear divergence in hardware behavior, with the IMX500 achieving the highest utilization (86.2 MAC/cycle) and the lowest energy-delay product, highlighting the growing significance and technological maturity of in-sensor processing. GAP9 offers the best energy efficiency within microcontroller-class power budgets, and the STM32N6 provides the lowest raw latency at a significantly higher energy cost. Together, the review and benchmarks provide a unified view of the current design directions and practical trade-offs that are shaping the next generation of ultra-low-power and in-sensor AI processors.

title: Timing Fragility Aware Selective Hardening of RISCV Soft Processors on SRAM Based FPGAs
abstract: Selective hardening is widely employed to improve the reliability of FPGA based soft processors while limiting the overhead of full redundancy. However, existing approaches primarily rely on architectural criticality or functional fault analysis, overlooking the impact of routing dependent timing sensitivity on processor robustness. This paper introduces a timing fragility aware selective hardening methodology for RISCV soft processors implemented on SRAM based FPGAs. Building on recent advances in in situ timing observability, the proposed approach quantifies the statistical timing sensitivity of pipeline components under controlled routing perturbations and uses this information to guide hardening decisions. Experimental results on a RISCV processor implemented on a commercial FPGA platform show that components exhibiting higher timing fragility also demonstrate increased vulnerability to routing induced delay effects. Leveraging this correlation, the proposed selective hardening strategy achieves robustness comparable to full hardening while significantly reducing area and timing overhead. These results demonstrate that timing fragility provides a practical and effective metric for reliability aware design optimization in FPGA based processor architectures.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 选择性硬化被广泛用于提高基于FPGA的软处理器的可靠性,同时限制全冗余的间接费用. 然而,现有方法主要依赖于建筑临界度或功能断层分析,忽略了路由依赖定时敏感性对处理器稳健性的影响. 【该句原文】This paper introduces a timing fragility aware selective hardening methodology for RISCV soft processors implemented on SRAM based FPGAs. 在近期实地时间安排可观察性进展的基础上,拟议办法量化了受控制路线扰动下管道部分的统计时间安排敏感性,并利用这一信息指导作出更硬化的决定。 在商业FPGA平台上执行的RISCV处理器的实验结果表明,时间脆弱性较高的组件也表明,更容易受到路由引起的延迟效应的影响。 利用这种相关性,拟议的有选择的硬化战略可以达到与完全硬化相当的强性,同时大大减少面积和时间上的间接费用。 这些结果显示,计时脆弱性为FPGA基处理器架构中的可靠意识设计优化提供了实用有效的衡量标准.

takeaway_source: Experimental results on a RISCV processor implemented on a commercial FPGA platform show that components exhibiting higher timing fragility also demonstrate increased vulnerability to routing induced delay effects.
Leveraging this correlation, the proposed selective hardening strategy achieves robustness comparable to full hardening while significantly reducing area and timing overhead.
innovation_source: Selective hardening is widely employed to improve the reliability of FPGA based soft processors while limiting the overhead of full redundancy.
This paper introduces a timing fragility aware selective hardening methodology for RISCV soft processors implemented on SRAM based FPGAs.

title: RISCBench: Benchmarking RISC-V Orchestration Efficiency in FPGA and FPGA-Like Computing Engines
abstract:
Heterogeneous systems increasingly rely on RISC-V cores as orchestration engines to manage data movement, synchronization, and scheduling across accelerators and reconfigurable fabrics. Conventional performance metrics, such as FLOPs, TOPS/W, or energy per operation, do not capture orchestration efficiency, even though it often dictates sustained system behavior. This gap is increasingly relevant as systems evolve toward tightly coupled heterogeneous fabrics and co-packaged accelerators, where control-plane behavior determines whether these platforms achieve their promised performance.
  We present RISCBench, a kernel benchmark suite and open methodology for quantifying orchestration efficiency. RISCBench introduces the Sustained Instantaneous Throughput (SIT) metric, which accumulates instantaneous throughput over near-aggregate execution intervals, capturing sustained efficiency beyond peak rates. The methodology is evaluated across representative platforms spanning soft and hard RISC-V orchestration engines, including FPGA-based prototyping and accelerator-class implementations. Results highlight synchronization and data residency driven tradeoffs that limit realized throughput beyond peak performance, motivating SIT as a practical, platform-independent descriptor for evaluating orchestration efficiency in heterogeneous systems and AI inference applications.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 异构系统越来越依赖RISC-V核心作为管弦引擎来管理数据移动,同步,以及跨加速器和可重组织物的排程. 常规性能衡量标准,如FLOPs,TOPS/W,或每次操作的能量,不能捕捉到管弦乐效率,尽管它经常支配持续的系统行为. 随着系统向紧密结合的异构织物和共同包装的加速器进化,这种差距越来越具有相关性,控制-飞机行为决定了这些平台是否实现了承诺的性能. 我们提出RISCBench,一个内核基准套件和量化管弦效率的开放方法. RISCBench引入了持续即时产出(SIT)度量衡,该度量值通过近总和的执行间隔积累瞬时的吞吐量,获取超过峰值率的持续效率. 该方法通过跨越软和硬RISC-V管弦发动机的代表性平台进行评价,包括FPGA-based原型和加速器级执行。 结果突出了同步和数据存储驱动的权衡,这些权衡限制了超过峰值性能的已实现的吞吐量,促使SIT成为评价异构系统和AI推理应用中的管弦效率的实用、独立的平台描述符。
takeaway: 在软核和硬核 RISC-V 编排平台上的评估表明，同步与数据驻留会制约实际吞吐量。持续瞬时吞吐量（SIT）能反映峰值指标之外的编排效率。
innovation: 1. 我们提出RISCBench,一个内核基准套件和量化管弦效率的开放方法.；2. RISCBench引入了持续即时产出(SIT)度量衡,该度量值通过近总和的执行间隔积累瞬时的吞吐量,获取超过峰值率的持续效率.

title: CHIME: Chiplet-based Heterogeneous Near-Memory Acceleration for Edge Multimodal LLM Inference
abstract: The proliferation of large language models (LLMs) is accelerating the integration of multimodal assistants into edge devices, where inference is executed under stringent latency and energy constraints, often exacerbated by intermittent connectivity. These challenges become particularly acute in the context of multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), as high-dimensional visual inputs are transformed into extensive token sequences, thereby inflating the key-value (KV) cache and imposing substantial data movement overheads to the LLM backbone. To address these issues, we present CHIME, a chiplet-based heterogeneous near-memory acceleration for edge MLLMs inference. CHIME leverages the complementary strengths of integrated monolithic 3D (M3D) DRAM and RRAM chiplets: DRAM supplies low-latency bandwidth for attention, while RRAM offers dense, non-volatile storage for weights. This heterogeneous hardware is orchestrated by a co-designed mapping framework that executes fused kernels near data, minimizing cross-chiplet traffic to maximize effective bandwidth. On FastVLM (0.6B/1.7B) and MobileVLM (1.7B/3B), CHIME achieves up to 54x speedup and up to 246x better energy efficiency per inference as compared to the edge GPU NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. It sustains 116.5-266.5 token/J compared to Jetson's 0.7-1.1 token/J. Furthermore, it delivers up to 69.2x higher throughput than the state-of-the-art PIM accelerator FACIL. Compared to the M3D DRAM-only design, CHIME's heterogeneous memory further improves energy efficiency by 7% and performance by 2.4x.

abstract_cn: 大型语言模型(LLMs)的激增正在加速将多式联运助手整合到边缘设备中,在这些设备中,推理是在严格的延迟和能量限制下执行的,而时断时续的连通性往往加剧了这种限制. 这些挑战在多式联运LLMs (MLLMs)中变得特别尖锐,因为高维视觉输入被转化为广泛的符号序列,从而夸大了密钥值(KV)缓存,并将大量数据移动管理费强加给LLM主干线。 为了解决这些问题,我们提出CHIME,一个基于芯片的异构,边缘近模加速MLLMs推理. CHIME 发挥集成单质3D(M3D)DRAM和RRAM芯片的互补优势:DRAM提供低纬度带宽供注意,而RRAM则提供密集的非挥发性存储重量. 这个异构硬件由一个共同设计的映射框架来设计,在数据附近执行引信内核,将跨芯流量最小化,以最大化有效带宽. 在FastVLM(0.6B/1.7B)和MobileVLM(1.7B/3B)上,CHIME实现最高54x加速,最高246x提高每推理节能,与边缘GPUNVIDIA杰森奥林NX相比. 它维持116.5-266.5令牌/J,而Jetson的0.7-1.1令牌/J. 此外,它提供的吞吐量比最先进的PIM加速器FACIL要高69.2x。 与M3DDRAM-only设计相比,CHIME的异构内存进一步提高了7%的能效,2.4x的性能.

title: Tri-Stack-PIM: A Heterogeneous Multi-Die 3D-Integrated Processing-in-Memory Architecture for Efficient LLM Inference
abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference during autoregressive decoding is fundamentally memory-bandwidth-bound. Existing three-dimensional (3D) stacked processing-in-memory (PIM) architectures alleviate the off-chip bandwidth wall, yet remain constrained by several limitations: physical layer (PHY), controllers, and direct memory access (DMA) engines compete with arithmetic units for advanced-node base-die area; hybrid-bonding keep-out zones fragment the base-die floorplan and impede physical design; compute tiles built in a dynamic random access memory (DRAM) process are restricted to low logic density, capping achievable throughput; and nonlinear operations offloaded to the host reintroduce a communication bottleneck. We present Tri-Stack-PIM, a heterogeneous three-die architecture that resolves these tensions by dedicating a top DRAM die to storage, a middle buffer die on a mature process node to PHYs, DMA engines, and near-memory compute units, and a bottom base die on an advanced node exclusively to single-instruction-multiple-data (SIMD) multiply-accumulate (MAC) arrays. We further introduce a Unified Buffer-Aware Ready-based (UBAR) hardware out-of-order micro-operation scheduler that enforces cross-die dependency correctness at runtime while maximizing issue-slot utilization through a multi-term priority function, recovering up to 90% of the cycles that an in-order policy would forfeit. A joint architecture-dataflow co-exploration identifies Pareto-optimal configurations that reduce the energy-delay product (EDP) by 33-66x over naive parameter selection. Evaluated across multi-head, grouped-query, and multi-query attention (MHA, GQA, MQA) mechanisms with batch sizes 1-32, Tri-Stack-PIM achieves geometric-mean speedups of 4.95x, 2.57x, and 1.68x across all three attention mechanisms and batch sizes over a graphics processing unit (GPU) baseline, AttAcc, and H2-LLM, respectively.

title: OpenRDMA: A GPU-Native Multi-Path Reliable RDMA Transport Architecture
abstract: As the computing power density of large-scale AI clusters rises, network communication increasingly limits system performance. GPU-initiated communication requires low-overhead request submission to overlap communication with computation. However, GPUDirect RDMA (GDR) still relies on CPU involvement in its control path, while InfiniBand GPUDirect Async (IBGDA) requires GPUs to assemble Work Queue Entries (WQEs), consuming additional SM resources and memory bandwidth. We propose OpenRDMA, an open-source multi-path reliable RDMA transport architecture designed for GPU-friendly communication. First, OpenRDMA provides a minimal GPU doorbell mechanism: the GPU issues an 8-byte token, and a dedicated FPGA NIC reconstructs the complete WQE from preconfigured context. Second, building on Multipath Reliable Connection (MRC), OpenRDMA supports per-packet multi-path transport and out-of-order arrivals, while selective retransmission, ordered DMA placement, and GPU-visible flag polling provide reliable delivery and safe data consumption. Third, a hardware-software co-designed retransmission mechanism keeps the GPU submission path lightweight and reduces FPGA hardware state overhead: the NIC handles fast data transfer, while CPU software manages complex timeout detection, state tracking, and recovery policies. We describe the architecture and key hardware components of OpenRDMA; implementation of the FPGA prototype is underway.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 随着大规模AI集群的计算功率密度上升,网络通信日益限制系统性能. GPU-initiated通信要求低管理费请求提交与计算重叠的通信. 然而,GPUDirectRDMA(GDR)仍然依赖CPU参与其控制路径,而InfiniBandGPUDirect Async(IBGDA)则要求GPUs组装工作队列(WQEs),消耗额外的SM资源和内存带宽. 我们提议OpenRDMA,一种为GPU-friendly通信设计的开源多路径可靠RDMA运输架构. 首先,OpenRDMA提供了一个最低限度的GPU门铃机制:GPU发行了一个8字节的符,一个专用的FPGANIC从预设的上下文重建了完整的WQE. 第二,在多路径可靠连接(MRC),OpenRDMA的基础上,支持每包多路径运输和乱序到达者,同时有选择地重新发送,命令放置DMA,GPU-visible旗民投票提供可靠的投递和安全的数据消耗. 第三,一个硬件-软件共同设计的再传输机制保持GPU提交路径轻量级并减少FPGA硬件状态的间接费用:NIC处理快速数据传输,而CPU软件管理复杂的超时检测,状态跟踪,和恢复政策. 我们描述OpenRDMA的架构和关键硬件组件;正在实施FPGA原型。

title: Naviq: An Open-Source System-on-Chip Simulator for Rapid Prototyping, Verification, and Design Space Exploration
abstract:
Modern FPGA SoCs are no longer just collections of accelerators on top of a programmable fabric. They combine programmable logic with hardened processors, NoCs, and components that dominate end-to-end performance. Evaluating individual pieces is insufficient; system performance depends on the interplay of SoC components. However, current FPGA SoC simulations provide limited support for this style of evaluation. Vendor simulations capture these interactions but are prohibitively slow for iterative design-space exploration. At the same time, generic software models overly abstract the hardware components that determine real behavior, resulting in less accurate simulations. Fast, easy-to-use simulators that accurately model real SoCs are critical for system debugging and design space exploration.
  We present Naviq, an open-source, cycle-level software simulator for FPGA SoCs, tuned to AMD Versal-class architectures. Naviq bridges accurate but slow vendor simulation and fast software modeling: it captures key behaviors of modern commercial FPGA SoCs while being fast enough for debugging and design-space exploration. Naviq models hardened SoC infrastructure in C++ and integrates accelerators through Verilator, allowing designers to evaluate custom hardware in a full-system environment. At the center of Naviq is an AXI4-compliant NoC model that captures transaction ordering, packetization, routing, backpressure, and memory interactions. Naviq provides CPU and memory integration, protocol checking, checkpointing, tracing, and performance-analysis tools for debugging and design-space exploration. Experimental results show Naviq closely reproduces the bandwidth and latency of Vivado's RTL NoC model while accelerating the evaluated simulations by 81x-182x. We present five case studies demonstrating Naviq's capabilities. Naviq enables practical full-system evaluation of modern FPGA SoC designs.

abstract_cn: 现代FPGA SoCs不再只是可编程织物之上的加速器的集合. 它们结合了可编程逻辑和硬化处理器,NoCs,以及支配端到端性能的组件. 单个片段的评价不足;系统性能取决于SoC组件的相互作用. 然而,目前的FPGASoC模拟为这种评价风格提供了有限的支持. 供应商模拟记录了这些相互作用,但在迭代设计-空间探索方面却极为缓慢。 同时,通用软件模型对决定真实行为的硬件组件过于抽象,导致模拟的准确性较低. 快速,易于使用的模拟器,准确的模型真实SoCs对系统调试和设计空间探索至关重要. 我们呈现Naviq,是用于FPGASoCs的开源,循环级软件模拟器,调制为AMDVersal级架构. Naviq桥梁准确但缓慢的供应商模拟和快速的软件建模:它捕捉现代商业的关键行为FPGASoCs,同时速度足够用于调试和设计-空间探索. Naviq模型在C++中加固了SoC基础设施,并通过Verilator集成加速器,使设计者可以在全系统环境下评价自定义硬件. 在Naviq的中心是一个AXI4-compliantNoC模型,它能捕捉交易的顺序,包化,路由,回压,以及内存的相互作用. title: Randomized Caches in Hardware: Challenges and Trade-offs
abstract: Randomized caches protect against side-channel attacks by obfuscating the mapping of memory addresses to cache locations. Existing proposals typically describe architectural behavior, leaving practical hardware implementation challenges largely unexplored. We implement four prominent designs, CEASER-S, ScatterCache, SassCache, and MIRAGE, and integrate them as the last-level cache (LLC) of a multi-core out-of-order RISC-V system-on-chip (SoC). We identify common and design-specific implementation challenges and develop practical solutions. We evaluate complete FPGA implementations by running SPEC CPU 2017 rate and GAPBS workloads to completion, providing, to our knowledge, the first comparative evaluation of these designs on a common full-system hardware platform. Pipelining the index derivation function (IDF) alone is insufficient: in three of the four variants, other components become the frequency bottleneck, reducing frequency by up to 35% relative to the baseline set-associative cache. Redesigning the critical paths while preserving mappings, rekeying, and victim-selection policies brings the three affected variants to no more than 10% below the baseline frequency, at the cost of added latency or reduced concurrency. Increased LLC access latency, rather than additional misses, dominates IPC degradation, reducing instructions per cycle by up to 5% for SPEC and 11% for GAPBS. Hardware overhead depends on the design and implementation technology: FPGA lookup-table usage increases by 10-35%, while ASIC area increases by 1-14%.

title: Operating System Support for Accelerators as First-Class Compute Elements in Heterogeneous Systems
abstract:
Heterogeneous systems-on-chip (SoCs) increasingly rely on domain-specific hardware accelerators (HAs) to deliver performance and energy efficiency gains beyond what general-purpose processors can provide. However, operating systems (O/S), such as Linux, assume that processors are the Compute Elements (CEs) and HAs are peripheral devices rather than specialized CEs. As a result, HA execution incurs substantial software (SW) overheads that reduce the effective benefits of hardware (HW) acceleration.
  This work demonstrates that significant inefficiencies arise from ``O/S peripheral device taxes'' (O/S taxes), including SW stack-accelerator communication, invocation, interrupt handling, and scheduling. We built MEERKAT, a Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA)-based framework for configurable multicore systems that include HAs; it allows the user to migrate Linux O/S support from SW to HW and identify, study, and quantify the impact. Here we study four major sources of O/S tax and introduce techniques to mitigate them. These include a virtual-memory-aware (VMA) communication method that enables efficient HA access to application data, a lightweight HA invocation interface, Interrupt Policy Adaptation (IPA) for dynamic polling and interrupt selection, and an HA-aware scheduler that dynamically distributes work across Central Processing Units (CPUs) and multiple HA instances.
  Experimental results demonstrate up to $260\times$ faster communication and $2$--$6\times$ performance improvements in wall-clock time over conventional schedulers. Furthermore, our study reveals that overall system performance depends not only on HA speed, but also on O/S overheads, resource availability, and scheduling decisions. These findings highlight the importance of treating HAs as first-class computational resources and motivate a more accelerator-centric O/S design for future heterogeneous systems.

title: M3D-FLOW: A Monolithic 3-D-Stackable Processing-Near-DRAM Architecture for Generative Normalizing Flow Applications
abstract: Normalizing Flows (NFs) have shown strong results in generative modeling, recently reaching state-of-the-art image generation performance. However, their repetitive, sequential operations limit the computational and memory efficiency achievable with GPUs and TPUs. We propose M3D-FLOW, a novel monolithic 3D-stackable (M3D) DRAM-based processing-near-memory (PNM) architecture that eliminates memory bottlenecks using a Cu-Cu hybrid-bonded logic die integrated with an M3D DRAM die. The M3D DRAM provides dense bank integration and a tiered organization with variable access latencies that M3D-FLOW exploits for the efficient processing of different NF workloads. To maximize compute density while minimizing area, energy, and thermal overhead, M3D-FLOW employs hybrid binary--stochastic floating-point multipliers, performing mantissa multiplication in the stochastic domain and exponent operations in the binary domain. A pipelined execution strategy maps sequential NF stages across dynamically partitioned PE groups, and together with the stochastic hardware, enables M3D-FLOW to achieve at least $6.6\times$ higher performance and $3\times$ better energy efficiency than prior PNM accelerators, with only a 2.2% bits-per-dimension (BPD) increase over bfloat16 and 4.1% over FP32. An analysis of stochastic hardware variants further shows that shorter stochastic bitstreams reduce execution time by up to $3.3\times$ at the cost of higher approximation error, providing a concrete design guide for latency--accuracy trade-offs.
