title: MemLLM: End-to-end In-Storage Acceleration of On-device Retrieval-Augmented Generation using Precomputed KV Caches
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) on edge devices enables personalized large language model (LLM) inference while preserving privacy. However, RAG's inherent length asymmetry makes the prefill phase the dominant bottleneck. While precomputing the KV caches offline alleviates the prefill cost on server systems, the multi-gigabyte caches over the narrow interconnect create a severe I/O wall for on-device systems. To mitigate this, we propose MemLLM, an end-to-end in-storage processing (ISP) architecture that executes the complete attention pipeline based on precomputed KV caches within the SSD. MemLLM utilizes per-channel accelerators to fully utilize the aggregated NAND channel bandwidth and accelerates all KV cache-related computations on the storage-side to minimize PCIe transfers. To efficiently handle the sparse updates required by RAG, MemLLM introduces a fused recomputation-query kernel paired with a hardware-based filter logic to halve the NAND read volume and eliminate write-back penalties. Furthermore, MemLLM's global SRAM-based stateful reduction engine enables a completely DRAM-less dataflow, thereby removing the internal memory bottlenecks and bounding the PCIe egress to an $O(1)$ footprint. A full-stack software stack allows asynchronous, zero-copy transfers from the ISP to the host and provides transparent execution within modern ML frameworks. Evaluated across eight real-world RAG datasets and six on-device LLM models, MemLLM achieves an average end-to-end speedup of 4.06$\times$ over the GPU baseline.

title: Helix: A Unified Programmable Accelerator for Diverse Krylov Subspace Solvers
abstract: Domain-specific accelerators deliver high performance and energy efficiency through specialization but often lack support for extensible algorithm families. Existing FPGA accelerators for Krylov subspace methods, which iteratively solve sparse linear systems, typically support a single solver or require separate hardware configurations. Helix follows a systematic algorithm-family design methodology that first abstracts common computational primitives from diverse Krylov solvers and builds the architecture around efficient, programmable primitive kernels. Helix then introduces programmable datapaths to coordinate these primitives. Its architecture decouples hardware implementation from solver-specific execution, enabling HBM reuse and zero solver-switching latency. Finally, Helix provides a DSL compiler that efficiently maps different solvers onto the architecture while optimizing vector-operation performance for each solver. We prototype Helix on a Xilinx Alveo U55C FPGA and evaluate Helix's practicality and performance by using it to compile and execute eight solvers. Helix achieves up to 7.91x and 1.16x speedups over Xilinx XcgSolver and the state-of-the-art FPGA accelerator Callipepla, respectively, both of which support only JPCG. Across the eight solvers, Helix sustains 47.5% - 96.9% of the throughput of an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU while delivering 2.29x - 4.66x higher energy efficiency and 1.89x - 3.85x higher throughput per unit peak memory bandwidth. The programmable components incur 0.25% - 0.57% execution-time overhead and 4.7% LUT and 4.0% FF overhead, demonstrating negligible overhead for programmability.

title: CHIPSMORE: Compute-in-Interconnect and -Memory Chiplets for Multi-Mode Multi-Request LLM Inference Acceleration
abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference exhibits substantial variability across adaptation modes, context lengths, and request concurrency, creating challenges for maintaining high utilization, memory efficiency, and scalable performance on compute-in-memory (CIM) accelerators. This paper presents CHIPSMORE, a multi-mode and multi-request LLM inference accelerator that integrates compute-in-interconnect and CIM to support both base-mode and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) inference under diverse workloads. CHIPSMORE employs heterogeneous processing elements consisting of resistive RAM analog compute-in-memory (RRAM-ACIM) and static RAM digital compute-in-memory (SRAM-DCIM) interconnected through a programmable Inter-PE computational network (IPCN). A composable hierarchical key-value (KV) memory scheme dynamically allocates router scratchpad, SRAM-DCIM, and embedded DRAM (eDRAM) resources according to workload requirements, enabling scalable support for long-context and batched inference. Furthermore, a non-replicated multi-request execution pipeline exploits request-level parallelism without duplicating pretrained weights, while a state-aware resource reconfiguration mechanism selectively retains runtime states and power-gates inactive resources to improve energy efficiency. Evaluation using cycle-accurate hardware-software co-simulation demonstrates that CHIPSMORE effectively sustains high throughput across varying model sizes, context lengths, and batch sizes while maintaining favorable power scaling. Compared with Nvidia H100, CHIPSMORE achieves up to $2.38\times$ higher throughput and $27\times$ higher energy efficiency on Mistral-7B inference while eliminating weight replication for multi-request serving.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 大型语言模型(LLM)推理在适应模式、上下文长度和请求货币方面显示出很大差异,为在计算(CIM)加速器上保持高利用率、内存效率和可扩展性能带来了挑战。 本文提出CHIPSMORE,一种多模式和多请求LLM推理加速器,将计算互联和CIM结合,在多样性工作负载下支持基准模式和低等级适应(LoRA)推理. CHIPSMORE采用异构处理元件,由阻性RAM模拟计算(RRAM-ACIM)和静态RAM数字计算(SRAM-DCIM)组成,通过可编程Inter-PE计算网络(IPCN)相互连接. 根据工作负载的要求,一个可混合的分级密钥-值(KV)内存方案能动态地分配路由器抓取板,SRAM-DCIM,以及嵌入式的DRAM(eDRAM)资源,使得长文本和分批推理的可缩放支持成为可能. 此外,一个不重复的多请求执行管道利用请求层面的平行性,而不重复预先受过训练的权重,而国家意识到的资源重组机制有选择地保留运行时间状态和电源门不活动资源,以提高能源效率。 使用循环精确硬件软件共模拟的评价表明,CHIPSMORE在保持有利功率缩放的同时,有效维持不同模型大小,上下文长度,和批量大小的高吞吐量. 与Nvidia H100相比,CHIPSMORE在Mistral-7B推理上实现了最高2.38×更高的吞吐量和27×更高的能源效率,同时取消了对多要求服务的重量复制.

takeaway_source: Furthermore, a non-replicated multi-request execution pipeline exploits request-level parallelism without duplicating pretrained weights, while a state-aware resource reconfiguration mechanism selectively retains runtime states and power-gates inactive resources to improve energy efficiency.
Compared with Nvidia H100, CHIPSMORE achieves up to 2.38× higher throughput and 27× higher energy efficiency on Mistral-7B inference while eliminating weight replication for multi-request serving.
innovation_source: This paper presents CHIPSMORE, a multi-mode and multi-request LLM inference accelerator that integrates compute-in-interconnect and CIM to support both base-mode and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) inference under diverse workloads.

CHIPSMORE employs heterogeneous processing elements consisting of resistive RAM analog compute-in-memory (RRAM-ACIM) and static RAM digital compute-in-memory (SRAM-DCIM) interconnected through a programmable Inter-PE computational network (IPCN).

title: Assessing Triple Modular Redundancy for Wide-Link, Low-Latency NoC Routers: Reliability and Physical Design Challenges
abstract: Protecting the Network-on-Chip (NoC) of physical-AI tile-based accelerators deployed in harsh environments against single-event effects (SEEs) is paramount for preventing NoC failures that can lead to deadlocks and silent data corruption (SDC). Prior work on reliable NoCs has largely focused on narrow links (e.g., 32-bit), deeply pipelined routers, and single-event upsets (SEUs). However, the state of the art has evolved toward low-latency NoC routers with ultra-wide links, implemented on advanced technology nodes and operating at frequencies above 1 GHz. We evaluate the cost and reliability trade-offs of implementing Triple Modular Redundancy (TMR) at three granularities (coarse, state-only, and full) for a 2-cycle-latency NoC router with 512-bit wide links. We carry out RTL-to-GDSII physical design in TSMC 7nm technology, as well as both RTL- and netlist-level SEU and SET fault injection campaigns. We evaluate the three TMR approaches in terms of reliability, cost, and physical design strategies, further extending the assessment from a standalone router to a full AI acceleration tile. Our results show that state-only and coarse-grained TMR do not provide sufficient protection against SEEs, whereas full TMR eliminates all observed failures across more than one million injected faults per experiment. Although the standalone full-TMR router incurs a 7.04x area overhead, this cost is drastically amortized once integrated into a complete AI accelerator tile with processors and local L1 memories: the same design adds only 16.8% area and 15.2% power consumption under a GEMM benchmark at the system level, with the critical path of the tile entirely unaffected. These results demonstrate that advanced technology nodes provide sufficient routing capacity to make full TMR a practical and deployable solution for protecting NoCs in Physical AI systems operating in harsh environments.

title: ELiTeFormer: An Efficient Transformer for FPGAs
abstract: Transformer blocks are prevalent in large language model (LLM) but present deployment challenges due to their challenging computational and memory demands. While prior work has typically optimized attention mechanisms or feed-forward networks (FFNs) separately, few hardware (HW) architecture have jointly addressed both components with co-designed hardware acceleration. We present ELiTeFormer (Efficient Linear Ternary Transformer), the first Transformer model architecture that unifies hybrid linear attention with ultra-low-precision (ternary) linear projections, specifically co-designed for field-programmable gate array (FPGA) deployment. ELiTeFormer achieves 10x model weight compression and 12.8x key-value (KV) cache compression compared to LLaMA 3, while maintaining competitive accuracy (31.9% on the MMLU benchmark, within 3.0% of BitNet b1.58). Our key architectural contribution is a novel processing element (PE) micro-architecture that eliminates all multiplications in ternary linear projections through bitmasking operations, significantly reducing resource utilization by completely avoiding dedicated digital signal processing (DSP) blocks. We simulate, synthesize, and deploy ELiTeFormer targeting a Xilinx VCK5000 Versal board using high-level synthesis (HLS) flows. Block-level simulations show 9.6x speedup for FFN operations and 4.4x speedup for attention compared to standard implementations. End-to-end deployment achieves up to 3.9x lower latency and 3.2x better energy efficiency than LLaMA 3 on an NVIDIA A100 graphics processing unit (GPU) at long context lengths. This represents the first FPGA realization combining linear attention with ternary quantization, demonstrating the viability of algorithm-architecture co-design for next-generation LLM acceleration.

title: High-Performance NTT Accelerators for PQC leveraging Unified Redundant Arithmetic and Fine-Tuned Microarchitecture
abstract: Post-quantum cryptography and privacy-preserving technologies are expected to play a central role in future secure communication systems. Lattice-based PQC schemes such as ML-KEM (CRYSTALS-Kyber) and ML-DSA (CRYSTALS-Dilithium) rely heavily on large-degree polynomial arithmetic, making the Number Theoretic Transform (NTT) a key computational primitive. Although existing hardware accelerators exploit parallelism and pipelining to support both NTT and INTT, their efficiency is often limited by the overhead of modular reduction and correction steps, inverse-transform scaling operations, and suboptimal FPGA implementations. This work addresses these limitations by proposing parallel iterative NTT/INTT accelerators based on optimized unified butterfly units. We introduce a novel redundant number representation that eliminates conditional corrections for both Montgomery modulo multiplication and combined subtract-multiply operations, and integrate inverse-transform scaling into existing arithmetic hardware to avoid dedicated scaling units. Furthermore, we design hierarchical Montgomery multipliers that map efficiently onto FPGA DSP resources, reducing hardware cost while enabling high operating frequencies. FPGA-based experimental results demonstrate higher clock frequencies, reduced execution times, and competitive resource utilization, supporting efficient NTT acceleration for PQC and related privacy-preserving applications.

abstract_cn: 预计后量子加密和隐私保护技术在未来的安全通信系统中将发挥核心作用。 基于Lattice的PQC方案,如ML-KEM(CRYSTALS-Kyber)和ML-DSA(CRYSTALS-Dilithium)严重依赖大度多元算术,使得数字理论变换(NTT)成为关键的计算原始. 虽然现有的硬件加速器利用平行性和管道线支持NTT和INTT,但其效率往往受到模块化减少和校正步骤、逆变缩放操作和次优化FPGA执行的间接费用的限制。 这项工作通过在优化的统一蝴蝶单位基础上提出平行迭代NTT/INTT加速器来解决这些局限性. 我们引入了一种新的冗余数字表示法,取消了对蒙哥马利modulo乘法和合并减法乘法操作的有条件的校正,并将逆变缩放法整合到现有的算术硬件中,以避免专用的缩放单位. 此外,我们设计了层次分明的蒙哥马利乘数,将高效地映射到FPGADSP资源上,降低硬件成本,同时允许高运行频率. FPGA-based实验结果显示时钟频率较高,执行时间缩短,资源利用具有竞争力,支持高效的NTT加速PQC及相关的隐私保护应用.

title: Dead on Arrival: Characterizing and Protecting Against Dead-Entry TLB Misses in GPU Microarchitectures
abstract: GPU workloads with large memory footprints frequently suffer from redundant L2 TLB misses in which a recently evicted translation is immediately re-walked at full page-walk cost. We characterize these dead-entry misses across 24 GPU workloads, finding they account for up to 99% of L2 TLB misses in the most TLB-sensitive applications, yet their performance impact varies widely depending on memory access structure. Workloads where warps share the same virtual page suffer from burst amplification, where a single eviction stalls many warps simultaneously waiting for one translation to return. In contrast, workloads where each warp accesses a distinct set of pages face a capacity-overflow problem that no replacement policy can resolve, a distinction validated by huge page experiments. Building on this two-class taxonomy, we design DEPOT (Dead-Entry PrOTection), a 1 KB Bloom filter mechanism that prevents recently evicted translations from being displaced immediately upon reinstallation, delivering up to 72% IPC improvement on interference-driven workloads with zero overhead on others, and composing with the state-of-the-art TLB prefetching and compaction mechanism, for 2 to 7% additional gain.
abstract_cn: GPU 工作负载 内存足迹大 经常出现冗余的L2TLB缺失,其中最近被拆迁的翻译立即以全页行走成本重新行走. 我们在24个GPU 工作负载中描述这些死亡输入缺失,发现在大多数TLB-sensitive应用程序中它们占L2TLB缺失的高达99%,但其性能影响却因内存访问结构而大不相同. 工作负载,warps共享同一个虚拟页面会受到爆裂放大的困扰,一个单次驱逐会同时拖住许多warps等待一个翻译返回. 相比之下,工作负载,在每一个曲面访问一组不同的页面时,都面临一个能力过量的问题,任何替换政策都无法解决,这个区别被巨大的页面实验验证. 基于这一两类分类,我们设计了DEPOT(Dead-EntryPrOTection),一个1KB Bloom过滤机制,防止最近被驱赶的翻译在重新安装后立即被转移,在干扰驱动工作负载上提供高达72%的IPC改进,对他人进行零管理,并与最先进的TLB前置和紧凑机制相结合,增加2%至7%的收益。

title: DORA: Dataflow-Instruction Orchestration Architecture for DNN Acceleration
abstract:
As deep neural networks develop significantly more diverse and complex, achieving high performance and efficiency on complicated DNN models faces pressing challenges. Modern DNN workloads are increasingly diverse in operation types, tensor shapes, and execution dependencies, making it difficult to sustain high hardware efficiency across models. In addition, a generic accelerator often incurs substantial overhead when executing diverse workloads.
  To address these problems, we propose DORA, an instruction-based overlay architecture that explicitly describes dataflow via a proposed ISA, enabling fine-grained control of data movement, computation, and synchronization at the layer level. To support flexibility while achieving high performance, DORA adopts a novel on-chip memory management and computation parallelism management mechanism. DORA proposes a compilation framework that can generate instructions for given DNN workloads after a two-stage design space exploration. DORA framework also incorporates a MILP-based and a heuristic-based search engine to generate the schedule solution for different needs and constraints.
  We prototype DORA on the AMD Versal VCK190 platform, demonstrating its deployability on existing reconfigurable systems. Experimental results show that DORA maintains stable efficiency, with less than 5\% variation on a single vector processor across workloads exhibiting up to 6$\times$ variation in operation counts. Compared to state-of-the-art accelerators, DORA consistently achieves higher performance, delivering up to 5$\times$ throughput improvement. The heuristic-based scheduler further achieves up to 90\% optimality under practical time constraints. DORA is open-sourced at https://github.com/arc-research-lab/DORA.git.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 随着深层神经网络的发展明显更加多样和复杂,在复杂的DNN模型上实现高性能和效率面临着紧迫的挑战. 现代DNN 工作负载在操作类型,拉伸形状,以及执行依赖性方面越来越多样化,使得各模型之间难以保持高硬件效率. 此外,一个通用加速器在执行不同的工作负载时,往往会产生大量的间接费用。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议DORA,一个基于指令的叠加结构,通过提议的ISA明确描述数据流,从而能够精细地控制数据移动、计算和层层同步。 为了支持灵活性,同时实现高性能DORA,采用了新型芯片上存储器管理和计算平行管理机制. DORA提出一个汇编框架,可以在两个阶段设计空间探索之后生成给定的DNN工作负载指令. DORA框架还包含一个MILP-based和一个基于huristic的搜索引擎,以生成满足不同需要和制约的时间表解决方案. 我们在AMD Versal VCK190平台上原型DORA,展示其在现有可重组系统中的可部署性. 【该句原文】Experimental results show that DORA maintains stable efficiency, with less than 5% variation on a single vector processor across workloads exhibiting up to 6× variation in operation counts. 与最先进的加速器相比,DORA始终实现更高的性能,提供最多5×的吞吐量改进. 高压计时器在实际的时间限制下进一步达到90%的优化。 DORA开源于https://github.com/arc-research-lab/DORA.git.

The heuristic-based scheduler further achieves up to 90% optimality under practical time constraints.

title: A complete discussion on fully reconfigurable, digital, scalable, graph and sparsity-aware near-memory accelerator for graph neural networks
abstract:
Graph neural networks (GNNs) have gained significant interest for applications such as citation network analysis and drug discovery due to their ability to apply machine learning techniques on graph-structured data. GNNs typically employ a two-stage execution pipeline consisting of combination and aggregation kernels. The combination stage performs data-intensive convolution operations with relatively regular memory access patterns, whereas the aggregation stage operates on sparse graph data with highly irregular accesses. These heterogeneous memory behaviors make conventional CPU- and GPU-based execution energy inefficient due to substantial data movement overheads.
  Existing accelerators attempt to mitigate these challenges using specialized architectures and processing-in-memory (PIM) techniques. However, prior approaches often suffer from scalability limitations, area overheads, restricted parallelism, and energy inefficiencies associated with analog compute and dedicated accelerator structures.
  This paper presents NEM-GNN, a scalable DAC/ADC-less processing-in-memory architecture for graph neural network acceleration. The proposed design introduces early compute termination mechanisms, pre-computation using reconfigurable system-on-chip components, and graph- and sparsity-aware near-memory aggregation using a compute-as-soon-as-ready (CAR) and broadcast-based execution model. Experimental results demonstrate that NEM-GNN achieves approximately 80--230x higher performance, 80--300x higher throughput, 850--1134x better energy efficiency, and 7--8x higher compute density compared to prior state-of-the-art approaches.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 图形神经网络(GNNs)因其在图形结构数据上应用机器学习技术的能力而获得了引用网络分析和药物发现等应用的极大兴趣. GNNs一般采用由组合内核和聚合内核组成的两阶段执行管道. 组合阶段进行数据密集的演化操作,内存访问模式相对正常,而聚合阶段则在数量稀少的图数据上运行,访问高度不规则. 这些异构内存行为使得常规CPU-和GPU-based执行能量效率低下,因为有大量的数据移动超高. 现有的加速器试图利用专门的架构和存内计算(PIM)技术来缓解这些挑战. 然而,以往的办法往往受到可伸缩性限制、地区间接费用、有限的平行性以及模拟计算和专用加速器结构的能源效率低下的影响。 本文提出NEM-GNN,一个可缩放的DAC/ADC-less存内计算结构,用于图神经网络加速. 拟议设计引入了早期计算终止机制,使用可重构系统芯片组件进行预计算,以及采用计算即时(CAR)和广播式执行模式进行图和溅射近视聚合。 实验结果显示,NEM-GNN与以往最先进的方法相比,实现了约80-230x更高的性能,80-300x更高的吞吐量,850-1134x更高的能效,7-8x的计算密度更高.

title: FPGA-Accelerated Lock Management and Transaction Processing: Architecture, Optimization, and Design Space Exploration
abstract:
Online Transaction Processing (OLTP) is a classic application with a growing business. CPU-based OLTP has low lock serving efficiency. The main reason is that most locks are cold, and the lock agent must issue frequent memory accesses to retrieve the lock details to determine whether to grant it. This motivates us to propose dedicated hardware-based lock agents with integrated lock tables to remove the DRAM access overhead.
  In this paper, we propose hardware-accelerated lock management and transaction processing for database systems. First, we propose a low-latency lock agent optimized for both lock acquiring and releasing requests. Second, we design a scalable transaction agent that executes the full transaction lifecycle. We present the architecture, optimizations, and design-space exploration of the proposed lock management and transaction processing system. The experiment results show up to 51X higher transaction throughput over the CPU baseline on the TPC-C benchmark.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 在线交易处理(OLTP)是业务不断增长的经典应用程序. CPU-based OLTP 低锁服务效率. 主要原因是大多数锁是冷的,锁的代理必须经常发布内存访问,以检索锁的细节,以确定是否批准. 这促使我们提出具有集成锁表的基于硬件的专用锁代理,以去除DRAM访问机顶. 在本文中,我们提议对数据库系统进行硬件加速锁管理和交易处理. 首先,我们提出一个低纬度锁剂 优化,既用于锁定获取 也用于释放请求。 第二,我们设计一个可扩展的交易代理 执行整个交易周期。 我们介绍了拟议的锁管理和交易处理系统的架构、优化和设计-空间探索。 实验结果显示,在TPC-C基准的CPU基线上,交易吞吐量最高达51X.

title: AMMA: A Multi-Chiplet Memory-Centric Architecture for Low-Latency 1M Context Attention Serving
abstract:
All current LLM serving systems place the GPU at the center, from production-level attention-FFN disaggregation to NVIDIA's Rubin GPU-LPU heterogeneous platform. Even academic PIM/PNM proposals still treat the GPU as the central hub for cross-device communication. Yet the GPU's compute-rich architecture is fundamentally mismatched with the memory-bound nature of decode-phase attention, inflating serving latency while wasting power and die area on idle compute units. The problem is compounded as reasoning and agentic workloads push context lengths toward one million tokens, making attention latency the primary user-facing bottleneck.
  To address these inefficiencies, we present AMMA, a multi-chiplet, memory-centric architecture for low-latency long-context attention. AMMA replaces GPU compute dies with HBM-PNM cubes, roughly doubling the available memory bandwidth to better serve memory-bound attention workloads. To translate this bandwidth into proportional performance gains, we introduce (i) a logic-die microarchitecture that fully exploits per-cube internal bandwidth for decode attention under a minimal power and area budget, (ii) a two-level hybrid parallelism scheme, and (iii) a reordered collective flow that reduces intra-chip die-to-die communication overhead. We further conduct a design-space exploration over per-cube compute power and intra-chip D2D link bandwidth, providing actionable guidance for hardware designers. Evaluations show that AMMA achieves 15.5X lower attention latency and 6.9X lower energy consumption compared with the NVIDIA H100.

AMMA用HBM-PNM立方体取代GPU计算死亡,大致将可用的内存带宽增加一倍,以更好地服务内存约束的注意工作负载. 为了将这种带宽转化为比例性能增益,我们引入了(一) 逻辑-die 微体系结构,在最小的功率和面积预算下,充分利用每个立方体内部的带宽来解码注意力,(二) 两级混合平行计划,(三) 重新排序的集体流量,以减少芯片内死-死-死通信的间接费用. 我们还对每个立方体的计算功率和芯片内部D2D链接带宽进行设计-空间探索,为硬件设计者提供可操作的指导. 评价显示,与NVIDIAH100相比,AMMA实现了15.5X低关注度和6.9X低能耗.

title: PC2IM: An Efficient In-Memory Computing Accelerator for 3D Point Cloud
abstract: 3D point cloud neural networks have significantly enhanced the perceptual capabilities of resource-limited mobile intelligent systems. However, despite the transformative impact, the point cloud algorithm suffers from substantial memory access during data preprocessing and imposes a burdensome workload on feature computing, resulting in high energy consumption and latency. In this paper, an efficient SRAM-based computing-in-memory (SRAM-CIM) accelerator (PC2IM), is proposed to alleviate memory access bottlenecks in point-based 3D point cloud networks. A data preprocessing module driven by the customized CIM engines is proposed and incorporated into a memory-efficient data flow. Specifically, an approximate distance SRAM-CIM (APD-CIM) is introduced to eliminate the repetitive on-chip memory access for point clouds that are spatially partitioned by the median and reduce the volume of temporary distance data. Building on the APD-CIM, a two-level Ping-Pong-MAX Content Addressable Memory (Ping-Pong-MAX CAM) is introduced to adaptively update temporary distances and perform in-situ search for the maximum, further reducing memory access. Additionally, an efficient CIM-based feature computing engine, named split-concatenate SRAM-CIM, is presented to minimize computation latency in multi-layer perceptron with high-precision input, while maintaining high area and energy efficiency. Experiment results show that the proposed PC2IM demonstrates 1.5x speedup and 2.7x enhanced energy efficiency compared to state-of-the-art point cloud accelerator. Moreover, PC2IM achieves 3.5x speedup and 1518.9x enhanced energy efficiency compared to GPU implementations.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 3D点云神经网络显著提升了资源有限的移动智能系统的感知能力. 然而,尽管产生了变革性影响,点云算法在数据预处理过程中仍然有大量内存访问,对特征计算造成负担工作负载,导致高能耗和耐久性. 在本文中,建议使用高效的SRAM-based计算内置(SRAM-CIM)加速器(PC2IM),以减轻点基3D点云网络中的内存访问瓶颈. 提出了由定制的CIM引擎驱动的数据处理预处理模块,并纳入内存高效的数据流中. 具体来说,引入了近似距离SRAM-CIM(APD-CIM),以消除点云被中位数空间分割的重复性芯片内存访问,并减少临时距离数据的量. 在APD-CIM的基础上,引入了两级Ping-Pong-MAX内容可处理内存(Ping-Pong-MAXCAM),以适应性地更新临时距离,并进行现场搜索以达到最大,进一步减少内存访问. 此外,还展示了一个高效的CIM-based特性计算引擎,命名为分位-连体SRAM-CIM,以尽量减少多层感应器中高精度输入的计算延迟,同时保持高面积和能效. 实验结果显示,与最先进的点云加速器相比,拟议的PC2IM显示1.5x加速,2.7x提高了能效. 此外,PC2IM与GPU的实施相比,实现了3.5x加速,1518.9x提高了能效.
takeaway: 实验结果显示,与最先进的点云加速器相比,拟议的PC2IM显示1.5x加速,2.7x提高了能效. 此外,PC2IM与GPU的实施相比,实现了3.5x加速,1518.9x提高了能效.

Moreover, PC2IM achieves 3.5x speedup and 1518.9x enhanced energy efficiency compared to GPU implementations.

title: SNAP-V: A RISC-V SoC with Configurable Neuromorphic Acceleration for Small-Scale Spiking Neural Networks
abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have gained significant attention in edge computing due to their low power consumption and computational efficiency. However, existing implementations either use conventional System on Chip (SoC) architectures that suffer from memory-processor bottlenecks, or large-scale neuromorphic hardware that is inefficient and wasteful for small-scale SNN applications. This work presents SNAP-V, a RISC-V-based neuromorphic SoC with two accelerator variants: Cerebra-S (bus-based) and Cerebra-H (Network-on-Chip (NoC)-based) which are optimized for small-scale SNN inference, integrating a RISC-V core for management tasks, with both accelerators featuring parallel processing nodes and distributed memory. Experimental results show close agreement between software and hardware inference, with an average accuracy deviation of 2.62% across multiple network configurations, and an average synaptic energy of 1.05 pJ per synaptic operation (SOP) in 45 nm CMOS technology. These results show that the proposed solution enables accurate, energy-efficient SNN inference suitable for real-time edge applications.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: Spiking神经网络(SNNs)因其低功耗和计算效率,在边缘计算中获得了显著关注. 然而,现有的实施要么在芯片(SoC)架构上使用常规系统,这些架构受到内存-处理器瓶颈的影响,要么大规模神经形态硬件低效,对小型SNN应用来说是浪费的. 这部作品呈现了SNAP-V,一个RISC-V-based神经形态SoC,有两个加速器变体:Cerebra-S(基于巴士)和Cerebra-H(Network-on-Chip(NoC))为小型SNN推理优化,将一个RISC-V核心用于管理任务,其中加速器兼具平行处理节点和分布式内存. 实验结果显示软件与硬件推理之间有密切的一致,跨多个网络配置的平均精度偏差为2.62%,每突触操作的平均突触能量为1.05pJ(SOP)45nmCMOS技术. 这些结果表明,提议的解决方案能够实现准确,节能SNN推理,适合实时边缘应用.

title: A Persistent-State Dataflow Accelerator for Memory-Bound Linear Attention Decode on FPGA
abstract: Gated DeltaNet (GDN) is a linear attention mechanism that replaces the growing KV cache with a fixed-size recurrent state. Hybrid LLMs like Qwen3-Next use 75% GDN layers and achieve competitive accuracy to attention-only models. However, at batch-1, GDN decode is memory-bound on GPUs since the full recurrent state must be round-tripped through HBM every token. We show that this bottleneck is architectural, not algorithmic, as all subquadratic sequence models exhibit arithmetic intensities below 1 FLOP/B at decode time, making them more memory-bound than standard Transformers. We present an FPGA accelerator that eliminates this bottleneck by holding the full 2 MB recurrent state persistently in on-chip BRAM, converting the workload from memory-bound to compute-bound. Our design fuses the GDN recurrence into a five-phase pipelined datapath that performs only one read and one write pass over each state matrix per token, exploits Grouped Value Attention for paired-head parallelism, and overlaps preparation, computation, and output storage via dataflow pipelining. We explore four design points on an AMD Alveo U55C using Vitis HLS, varying head-level parallelism from 2 to 16 value-heads per iteration. Our fastest configuration achieves 63 $μ$s per token, 4.5$\times$ faster than the GPU reference on NVIDIA H100 PCIe. Post-implementation power analysis reports 9.96 W on-chip, yielding up to 60$\times$ greater energy efficiency per token decoded.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: Gated DeltaNet (GDN)是一种线性注意机制,它用固定大小的经常性状态取代了正在增长的KV缓存. Hybrid LLMs 类似 Qwen3-Next 使用75% GDN 层,并实现对只注意型号的竞争精度. 然而,在批次1,GDN解码时,内存绑在GPUs上,因为完整的重复状态必须经过HBM每个符号进行圆盘. 【该句原文】We show that this bottleneck is architectural, not algorithmic, as all subquadratic sequence models exhibit arithmetic intensities below 1 FLOP/B at decode time, making them more memory-bound than standard Transformers. 我们提出了一个FPGA加速器,通过在芯片上坚持保持完整的2MB经常性状态BRAM,将工作负载从内存键转换为计算键来消除这个瓶颈. 我们的设计将GDN的重现纳入一个五阶段的管道数据路径,该路径每个符号只执行一个读写通过每个状态矩阵,利用组合值注意对头平行,并通过数据流管道进行重叠的准备、计算和输出存储。 我们在使用Vitis HLS的AMD Alveo U55C上探索四个设计点,每个迭代2到16个值头的不同头级平行. 我们最快的配置每令牌达到63 μs,比NVIDIAH100 PCIe上的GPU引用快4.5×. 实施后功率分析报告 9.96 W上芯片,每个符号解码的能效最高可达60×更高.

title: Architectural Design and Performance Analysis of FPGA based AI Accelerators: A Comprehensive Review
abstract: Deep learning (DL) has emerged as a rapidly developing advanced technology, enabling the performance of complex tasks involving image recognition, natural language processing, and autonomous decision-making with high levels of accuracy. However, as these technologies evolve and strive to meet the growing demands of real-life applications, the complexity of DL models continues to increase. These models require processing of massive volumes of data, demanding substantial computational power and memory bandwidth. This gives rise to the critical need for hardware accelerators that can deliver both high performance and energy efficiency. Accelerator types include ASIC based solutions, GPU accelerators, and FPGA based implementations. The limitations of ASIC and GPU accelerators have led to FPGAs becoming one of the prominent solutions, offering distinct advantages for DL workloads. FPGAs provide a flexible and reconfigurable platform, allowing model specific customization while maintaining high efficiency. This article explores various hardware level optimizations for DL. These optimizations include techniques such as loop pipelining, parallelism, quantization, and various memory hierarchy enhancements. In addition, it provides an overview of state-of-the-art FPGA-based neural network accelerators. Through the study and analysis of these accelerators, several challenges have been identified, paving the way for future optimizations and innovations in the design of FPGA-based hardware accelerators.

abstract_cn: 深入学习(DL)作为一种迅速发展的先进技术出现,能够完成涉及图像识别,自然语言处理,以及高度精确的自主决策等复杂任务. 然而,随着这些技术的发展,并努力满足现实应用日益增长的需求,DL模型的复杂性继续增加. 这些模型需要处理大量的数据,要求大量的计算功率和内存带宽. 这导致迫切需要既能提供高性能又能提高能效的硬件加速器。 加速器类型包括基于ASIC的解决方案,GPU加速器,以及基于FPGA的实现. ASIC和GPU加速器的局限性导致FPGAs成为显著的解决方案之一,为DL工作负载提供了显著的优势. FPGAs提供了一个灵活和可重新配置的平台,允许模型特定定制,同时保持高效. 本條目為DL探索各种硬件级别优化. 这些优化包括环线管线,平行论,量子化,以及各种存储层次结构增强等技术. 此外,它还提供了最新的FPGA-based神经网络加速器的概况. 通过对这些加速器的研究和分析,发现了几个挑战,为未来设计FPGA-based硬件加速器的优化和创新铺平了道路.

title: FAST-Prefill: FPGA Accelerated Sparse Attention for Long Context LLM Prefill
abstract:
In long-context large language model (LLM) inference, the prefill stage dominates computation due to self-attention over the complete input context. Sparse attention significantly reduces self-attention computation by limiting each token's interactions to a subset of tokens. The attention sparsity pattern varies across input prompts, and within a prompt, each attention head can follow a distinct pattern. This makes attention sparsity dynamic. The requirement of generating the sparsity pattern, combined with limited data reuse in attention, shifts the prefill compute to being memory-bound. This, in addition to the huge energy requirements for long-context inference on GPU, motivates FPGAs as good candidates for accelerating dynamic long-context inference.
  To tackle these challenges, we propose FAST-Prefill, the first FPGA accelerator for long-context prefill-stage inference with dynamic sparse attention. To efficiently generate sparse indices, we propose a \textit{fused pipeline unit with a memory-aware execution order} to reduce large tensors and irregular memory accesses. To reduce off-chip memory traffic for accessing the KV cache, we utilize the memory hierarchy to design a \textit{liveness-driven, dual-tier cache}. For high-throughput matrix multiplication, we design a \textit{hybrid Matrix Processing Unit (MPU)} with DSPs and bit-plane decomposition using LUTs. We implement FAST-Prefill on Alveo U280 and evaluate it on the Llama and Qwen models (batch size = 1) for context lengths ranging from 4K to 128K tokens. We demonstrate an average speedup of up to 2.5$\times$ in TTFT and 4.5$\times$ improvement in energy efficiency over GPU implementation on Nvidia A5000 GPU.

title: ABI: A tightly integrated, unified, sparsity-aware, reconfigurable, compute near-register file/cache GPU architecture with light-weight softmax for deep learning, linear algebra, and Ising compute
abstract: We present a tightly integrated and unified near-memory GPU architecture that delivers 6 to 16 times speedup and 6 to 13 times energy savings across Convolutional Neural Networks, Graph Convolutional Networks, Linear Programming, Large Language Models, and Ising workloads compared to MIAOW GPU. The design includes a custom sparsity-aware near-memory circuit providing about 1.5 times energy savings, and a lightweight softmax circuit providing about 1.6 times energy savings. The architecture supports reconfigurable compute up to INT16 with dynamic resolution updates and scales efficiently across problem sizes. ABI-enabled MI300 and Blackwell systems achieve about 4.5 times speedup over baseline MI300 and Blackwell.
abstract_cn: 我们展示了一个紧密整合和统一的近现代GPU架构,它提供6至16倍的速度和6至13倍的能量节约,跨越了革命神经网络,图革命网络,线性编程,大语言模型,以及伊辛工作负载与MIAOWGPU. 该设计包括一个定制的Sparsity-aware近模电路,提供约1.5倍的节能,以及一个轻量级软马克斯电路,提供约1.6倍的节能. 该架构支持可重构的计算,最高可达INT16,并有动态分辨率更新和跨问题大小的高效尺度. ABI-enabled MI300和布莱克韦尔系统比基线MI300和布莱克韦尔达到约4.5倍的速度.

title: PIM-FW: Hardware-Software Co-Design of All-pairs Shortest Paths in DRAM
abstract: All-pairs shortest paths (APSP) is a fundamental algorithm used for routing, logistics, and network analysis, but the cubic time complexity and heavy data movement of the canonical Floyd-Warshall (FW) algorithm severely limits its scalability on conventional CPUs or GPUs. In this paper, we propose PIM-FW, a novel co-designed hardware architecture and dataflow that leverages processing in and near memory architecture designed to accelerate blocked FW algorithm on an HBM3 stack. To enable fine-grained parallelism, we propose a massively parallel array of specialized bit-serial bank PE and channel PE designed to accelerate the core min-plus operations. Our novel dataflow complements this hardware, employing an interleaved mapping policy for superior load balancing and hybrid in and near memory computing model for efficient computation and reduction. The novel in-bank computing approach allows all distance updates to be performed and stored in memory bank, a key contribution is that eliminates the data movement bottleneck inherent in GPU-based approaches. We implement a full software and hardware co-design using a cycle-accurate simulator to simulate an 8-channel, 4-Hi HBM3 PIM stack on real road-network traces. Experimental results show that, for a 8192 x 8192 graph, PIM-FW achieves a 18.7x speedup in end-to-end execution, and consumes 3200x less DRAM energy compared to a state-of-the-art GPU-only Floyd-Warshall.
